verses.2PE 2:1: Ἐγένοντο δὲ καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐν τῷ λαῷ, ὡς καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσονται ψευδοδιδάσκαλοι, οἵτινες παρεισάξουσιν αἱρέσεις 【ἀπωλείας,】 καὶ τὸν ἀγοράσαντα αὐτοὺς δεσπότην ἀρνούμενοι, ἐπάγοντες ἑαυτοῖς ταχινὴν 【ἀπώλειαν·】
verses.2PE 2:3: καὶ ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ πλαστοῖς λόγοις ὑμᾶς ἐμπορεύσονται· οἷς τὸ κρίμα ἔκπαλαι οὐκ ἀργεῖ, καὶ ἡ 【ἀπώλεια】 αὐτῶν οὐ νυστάζει.
verses.2PE 3:7: οἱ δὲ νῦν οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ τῷ αὐτῷ λόγῳ τεθησαυρισμένοι εἰσὶν πυρὶ τηρούμενοι εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως καὶ 【ἀπωλείας】 τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνθρώπων.
verses.2PE 3:16: ὡς καὶ ἐν πάσαις ἐπιστολαῖς λαλῶν ἐν αὐταῖς περὶ τούτων, ἐν αἷς ἐστιν δυσνόητά τινα, ἃ οἱ ἀμαθεῖς καὶ ἀστήρικτοι στρεβλοῦσιν ὡς καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς γραφὰς πρὸς τὴν ἰδίαν αὐτῶν 【ἀπώλειαν.】
verses.REV 17:8: τὸ θηρίον ὃ εἶδες ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν, καὶ μέλλει ἀναβαίνειν ἐκ τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ εἰς 【ἀπώλειαν】 ὑπάγει· καὶ θαυμασθήσονται οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, ὧν οὐ γέγραπται τὸ ὄνομα ἐπὶ τὸ βιβλίον τῆς ζωῆς ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, βλεπόντων τὸ θηρίον ὅτι ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ παρέσται.
verses.REV 17:11: καὶ τὸ θηρίον ὃ ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν, καὶ αὐτὸς ὄγδοός ἐστιν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἑπτά ἐστιν, καὶ εἰς 【ἀπώλειαν】 ὑπάγει.
verses.MAT 26:8: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἠγανάκτησαν λέγοντες Εἰς τί ἡ 【ἀπώλεια】 αὕτη;
verses.MRK 14:4: ἦσαν δέ τινες ἀγανακτοῦντες πρὸς ἑαυτούς Εἰς τί ἡ 【ἀπώλεια】 αὕτη τοῦ μύρου γέγονεν;

benchmark_ref.detail: destruction, ruin, loss, perishing; eternal ruin.

core_meaning_summary: To earn profit, acquire something of value, win people over, or spare oneself harm or loss.

senses.definition: To earn money or make a commercial profit through trade or investment.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active (transitive with monetary object or absolute)

senses.definition: To acquire or obtain something treated as a supreme prize or possession, contrasted with suffering loss.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active, transitive with accusative object

senses.definition: To win a person over to reconciliation, faith, or salvation.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active (transitive with personal object) or passive (with personal subject)

senses.definition: To spare oneself or avoid incurring an unwelcome hardship or loss by refraining from a course of action.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active, transitive with accusative objects of harm/loss following a negated infinitive

collocations_and_notes: Frequently contrasted with ζημιόω ("to suffer loss/forfeit") and ζημία ("loss") in MAT 16:26, MRK 8:36, LUK 9:25, ACT 27:21, and PHP 3:8. In 1CO 9:19–22 it occurs five times in purpose clauses (ἵνα) parallel to σώσω ("that I might save", 1CO 9:22). Notice the rare aorist subjunctive form κερδάνω in 1CO 9:21 alongside the sigmatic aorist forms elsewhere.

verses.MAT 25:16: πορευθεὶς ὁ τὰ πέντε τάλαντα λαβὼν ἠργάσατο ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ 【ἐκέρδησεν】 ἄλλα πέντε·
verses.MAT 25:17: ὡσαύτως ὁ τὰ δύο 【ἐκέρδησεν】 ἄλλα δύο.
verses.MAT 25:20: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ τὰ πέντε τάλαντα λαβὼν προσήνεγκεν ἄλλα πέντε τάλαντα λέγων Κύριε, πέντε τάλαντά μοι παρέδωκας· ἴδε ἄλλα πέντε τάλαντα 【ἐκέρδησα.】
verses.MAT 25:22: προσελθὼν καὶ ὁ τὰ δύο τάλαντα εἶπεν Κύριε, δύο τάλαντά μοι παρέδωκας· ἴδε ἄλλα δύο τάλαντα 【ἐκέρδησα.】
verses.JAS 4:13: Ἄγε νῦν οἱ λέγοντες Σήμερον ἢ αὔριον πορευσόμεθα εἰς τήνδε τὴν πόλιν καὶ ποιήσομεν ἐκεῖ ἐνιαυτὸν καὶ ἐμπορευσόμεθα καὶ 【κερδήσομεν·】
verses.MAT 16:26: τί γὰρ ὠφεληθήσεται ἄνθρωπος ἐὰν τὸν κόσμον ὅλον 【κερδήσῃ,】 τὴν δὲ ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ζημιωθῇ; ἢ τί δώσει ἄνθρωπος ἀντάλλαγμα τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ;
verses.MRK 8:36: τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖ ἄνθρωπον 【κερδῆσαι】 τὸν κόσμον ὅλον καὶ ζημιωθῆναι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ;
verses.LUK 9:25: τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖται ἄνθρωπος 【κερδήσας】 τὸν κόσμον ὅλον ἑαυτὸν δὲ ἀπολέσας ἢ ζημιωθείς;
verses.PHP 3:8: ἀλλὰ μὲν οὖν γε καὶ ἡγοῦμαι πάντα ζημίαν εἶναι διὰ τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου μου, δι’ ὃν τὰ πάντα ἐζημιώθην, καὶ ἡγοῦμαι σκύβαλα ἵνα Χριστὸν 【κερδήσω】
verses.MAT 18:15: Ἐὰν δὲ ἁμαρτήσῃ ὁ ἀδελφός σου, ὕπαγε ἔλεγξον αὐτὸν μεταξὺ σοῦ καὶ αὐτοῦ μόνου. ἐάν σου ἀκούσῃ, 【ἐκέρδησας】 τὸν ἀδελφόν σου·
verses.1CO 9:19: Ἐλεύθερος γὰρ ὢν ἐκ πάντων πᾶσιν ἐμαυτὸν ἐδούλωσα, ἵνα τοὺς πλείονας 【κερδήσω·】
verses.1CO 9:20: καὶ ἐγενόμην τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὡς Ἰουδαῖος, ἵνα Ἰουδαίους 【κερδήσω·】 τοῖς ὑπὸ νόμον ὡς ὑπὸ νόμον, μὴ ὢν αὐτὸς ὑπὸ νόμον, ἵνα τοὺς ὑπὸ νόμον 【κερδήσω·】
verses.1CO 9:21: τοῖς ἀνόμοις ὡς ἄνομος, μὴ ὢν ἄνομος Θεοῦ ἀλλ’ ἔννομος Χριστοῦ, ἵνα 【κερδάνω】 τοὺς ἀνόμους·
verses.1CO 9:22: ἐγενόμην τοῖς ἀσθενέσιν ἀσθενής, ἵνα τοὺς ἀσθενεῖς 【κερδήσω·】 τοῖς πᾶσιν γέγονα πάντα, ἵνα πάντως τινὰς σώσω.
verses.1PE 3:1: Ὁμοίως γυναῖκες, ὑποτασσόμεναι τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν, ἵνα καὶ εἴ τινες ἀπειθοῦσιν τῷ λόγῳ, διὰ τῆς τῶν γυναικῶν ἀναστροφῆς ἄνευ λόγου 【κερδηθήσονται,】
verses.ACT 27:21: Πολλῆς τε ἀσιτίας ὑπαρχούσης τότε σταθεὶς ὁ Παῦλος ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν εἶπεν Ἔδει μέν, ὦ ἄνδρες, πειθαρχήσαντάς μοι μὴ ἀνάγεσθαι ἀπὸ τῆς Κρήτης 【κερδῆσαί】 τε τὴν ὕβριν ταύτην καὶ τὴν ζημίαν.

benchmark_ref.detail: I gain, acquire, win (over), avoid loss.

core_meaning_summary: Intense emotional ardor or passion that manifests positively as devoted enthusiasm or concern, negatively as envious rivalry and hostility, or metaphorically as fierce, consuming intensity.

senses.definition: Ardent devotion, eager enthusiasm, or protective concern directed toward God, another person, or a cause.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun (masculine, or neuter in 2CO 9:2); occurs with objective genitives (τοῦ οἴκου σου, Θεοῦ), with κατά + accusative or ὑπέρ + genitive, and as an instrumental dative with the cognate verb ζηλῶ.

senses.definition: Hostile jealousy, resentment, or contentious rivalry toward others.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun; used as genitive complement of ἐπλήσθησαν ('were filled with'), object of ἔχω (modified by πικρός in JAS 3:14), or coordinated in lists with ἔρις and ἐριθεία.

senses.definition: Fierce, consuming intensity or fury, predicated of fire in judgment.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun modified by the genitive πυρός ('of fire') and acting as subject of the infinitive ἐσθίειν ('to consume').

collocations_and_notes: Often paired in vice lists or conflicts with ἔρις ("strife") and ἐριθεία ("selfish ambition/rivalry") (ROM 13:13; 1CO 3:3; 2CO 12:20; GAL 5:20; JAS 3:14, 3:16), and appears as the genitive complement of ἐπλήσθησαν ("were filled with") in ACT 5:17 and 13:45. In 2CO 11:2 it serves as a cognate dative with ζηλῶ (Θεοῦ ζήλῳ), expressing protective, betrothal-like devotion. Note the grammatical variation in 2CO 9:2, where it takes the neuter singular article τὸ (τὸ ὑμῶν ζῆλος), whereas elsewhere it is masculine (e.g., ὁ ζῆλος in JHN 2:17; τὸν ζῆλον in 2CO 7:7).

verses.JHN 2:17: ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι γεγραμμένον ἐστίν Ὁ 【ζῆλος】 τοῦ οἴκου σου καταφάγεταί με.
verses.ROM 10:2: μαρτυρῶ γὰρ αὐτοῖς ὅτι 【ζῆλον】 Θεοῦ ἔχουσιν, ἀλλ’ οὐ κατ’ ἐπίγνωσιν·
verses.2CO 7:7: οὐ μόνον δὲ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τῇ παρακλήσει ᾗ παρεκλήθη ἐφ’ ὑμῖν, ἀναγγέλλων ἡμῖν τὴν ὑμῶν ἐπιπόθησιν, τὸν ὑμῶν ὀδυρμόν, τὸν ὑμῶν 【ζῆλον】 ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ, ὥστε με μᾶλλον χαρῆναι.
verses.2CO 7:11: ἰδοὺ γὰρ αὐτὸ τοῦτο τὸ κατὰ Θεὸν λυπηθῆναι πόσην κατειργάσατο ὑμῖν σπουδήν, ἀλλὰ ἀπολογίαν, ἀλλὰ ἀγανάκτησιν, ἀλλὰ φόβον, ἀλλὰ ἐπιπόθησιν, ἀλλὰ 【ζῆλον,】 ἀλλὰ ἐκδίκησιν. ἐν παντὶ συνεστήσατε ἑαυτοὺς ἁγνοὺς εἶναι τῷ πράγματι.
verses.2CO 9:2: οἶδα γὰρ τὴν προθυμίαν ὑμῶν ἣν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καυχῶμαι Μακεδόσιν ὅτι Ἀχαΐα παρεσκεύασται ἀπὸ πέρυσι, καὶ τὸ ὑμῶν 【ζῆλος】 ἠρέθισεν τοὺς πλείονας.
verses.2CO 11:2: ζηλῶ γὰρ ὑμᾶς Θεοῦ 【ζήλῳ,】 ἡρμοσάμην γὰρ ὑμᾶς ἑνὶ ἀνδρὶ παρθένον ἁγνὴν παραστῆσαι τῷ Χριστῷ·
verses.PHP 3:6: κατὰ 【ζῆλος】 διώκων τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, κατὰ δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐν νόμῳ γενόμενος ἄμεμπτος.
verses.ACT 5:17: Ἀναστὰς δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ πάντες οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ, ἡ οὖσα αἵρεσις τῶν Σαδδουκαίων, ἐπλήσθησαν 【ζήλου】
verses.ACT 13:45: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τοὺς ὄχλους ἐπλήσθησαν 【ζήλου,】 καὶ ἀντέλεγον τοῖς ὑπὸ Παύλου λαλουμένοις βλασφημοῦντες.
verses.ROM 13:13: ὡς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ εὐσχημόνως περιπατήσωμεν, μὴ κώμοις καὶ μέθαις, μὴ κοίταις καὶ ἀσελγείαις, μὴ ἔριδι καὶ 【ζήλῳ·】
verses.1CO 3:3: ἔτι γὰρ σαρκικοί ἐστε. ὅπου γὰρ ἐν ὑμῖν 【ζῆλος】 καὶ ἔρις, οὐχὶ σαρκικοί ἐστε καὶ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖτε;
verses.2CO 12:20: φοβοῦμαι γὰρ μή πως ἐλθὼν οὐχ οἵους θέλω εὕρω ὑμᾶς, κἀγὼ εὑρεθῶ ὑμῖν οἷον οὐ θέλετε, μή πως ἔρις, 【ζῆλος,】 θυμοί, ἐριθεῖαι, καταλαλιαί, ψιθυρισμοί, φυσιώσεις, ἀκαταστασίαι·
verses.GAL 5:20: εἰδωλολατρεία, φαρμακεία, ἔχθραι, ἔρις, 【ζῆλος,】 θυμοί, ἐριθεῖαι, διχοστασίαι, αἱρέσεις,
verses.JAS 3:14: εἰ δὲ 【ζῆλον】 πικρὸν ἔχετε καὶ ἐριθείαν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν, μὴ κατακαυχᾶσθε καὶ ψεύδεσθε κατὰ τῆς ἀληθείας.
verses.JAS 3:16: ὅπου γὰρ 【ζῆλος】 καὶ ἐριθεία, ἐκεῖ ἀκαταστασία καὶ πᾶν φαῦλον πρᾶγμα.
verses.HEB 10:27: φοβερὰ δέ τις ἐκδοχὴ κρίσεως καὶ πυρὸς 【ζῆλος】 ἐσθίειν μέλλοντος τοὺς ὑπεναντίους.

benchmark_ref.detail: (a) eagerness, zeal, enthusiasm, (b) jealousy, rivalry.

core_meaning_summary: Inner sorrow, emotional grief, physical or situational distress, or grudging reluctance.

senses.definition: Deep emotional sorrow, grief, or heartache, whether felt internally or caused by another's conduct.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine singular noun; serves as subject of verbs (εἰμί, πληρόω, γίνομαι, ἐργάζομαι), direct object of ἔχω, or object of prepositions (ἀπό, ἐν); modified by adjectives (μεγάλη, περισσοτέρα) or qualifying phrases (κατὰ Θεόν, τοῦ κόσμου).

senses.definition: Pain, hardship, or distress arising from physical labor, discipline, or unjust mistreatment.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine noun, singular (object of ἔχω, or predicate genitive contrasted with χαρᾶς) or plural (object of ὑποφέρω in 1PE 2:19); paralleled with θλῖψις in JHN 16:21.

senses.definition: Grudging reluctance or inner unwillingness in giving, contrasted with cheerfulness.
senses.grammatical_frame: Feminine singular noun in the prepositional phrase ἐκ λύπης, coordinated with ἐξ ἀνάγκης ('out of compulsion').

collocations_and_notes: Frequently contrasted directly with χαρά ("joy") or χαίρω ("to rejoice") (JHN 16:20–22; 2CO 2:3; HEB 12:11) and paired with weeping, lamentation, or anguish (κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε in JHN 16:20; ἀδιάλειπτος ὀδύνη in ROM 9:2). In 2CO 7:10, two kinds are contrasted: ἡ κατὰ Θεὸν λύπη (producing repentance toward salvation) and ἡ τοῦ κόσμου λύπη (producing death). Idiomatic accumulation appears in PHP 2:27 (λύπην ἐπὶ λύπην, "sorrow upon sorrow"). In 2CO 9:7, ἐκ λύπης is paired with ἐξ ἀνάγκης ("out of compulsion") and contrasted with a cheerful giver (ἱλαρὸν δότην).

verses.LUK 22:45: καὶ ἀναστὰς ἀπὸ τῆς προσευχῆς, ἐλθὼν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς εὗρεν κοιμωμένους αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς 【λύπης,】
verses.JHN 16:6: ἀλλ’ ὅτι ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν, ἡ 【λύπη】 πεπλήρωκεν ὑμῶν τὴν καρδίαν.
verses.JHN 16:20: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε ὑμεῖς, ὁ δὲ κόσμος χαρήσεται· ὑμεῖς λυπηθήσεσθε, ἀλλ’ ἡ 【λύπη】 ὑμῶν εἰς χαρὰν γενήσεται.
verses.JHN 16:22: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν νῦν μὲν 【λύπην】 ἔχετε· πάλιν δὲ ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς, καὶ χαρήσεται ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία, καὶ τὴν χαρὰν ὑμῶν οὐδεὶς αἴρει ἀφ’ ὑμῶν.
verses.ROM 9:2: ὅτι 【λύπη】 μοί ἐστιν μεγάλη καὶ ἀδιάλειπτος ὀδύνη τῇ καρδίᾳ μου.
verses.2CO 2:1: ἔκρινα δὲ ἐμαυτῷ τοῦτο, τὸ μὴ πάλιν ἐν 【λύπῃ】 πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλθεῖν.
verses.2CO 2:3: καὶ ἔγραψα τοῦτο αὐτὸ ἵνα μὴ ἐλθὼν 【λύπην】 σχῶ ἀφ’ ὧν ἔδει με χαίρειν, πεποιθὼς ἐπὶ πάντας ὑμᾶς ὅτι ἡ ἐμὴ χαρὰ πάντων ὑμῶν ἐστιν.
verses.2CO 2:7: ὥστε τοὐναντίον μᾶλλον ὑμᾶς χαρίσασθαι καὶ παρακαλέσαι, μή πως τῇ περισσοτέρᾳ 【λύπῃ】 καταποθῇ ὁ τοιοῦτος.
verses.2CO 7:10: ἡ γὰρ κατὰ Θεὸν 【λύπη】 μετάνοιαν εἰς σωτηρίαν ἀμεταμέλητον ἐργάζεται· ἡ δὲ τοῦ κόσμου 【λύπη】 θάνατον κατεργάζεται.
verses.PHP 2:27: καὶ γὰρ ἠσθένησεν παραπλήσιον θανάτῳ· ἀλλὰ ὁ Θεὸς ἠλέησεν αὐτόν, οὐκ αὐτὸν δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐμέ, ἵνα μὴ 【λύπην】 ἐπὶ 【λύπην】 σχῶ.
verses.JHN 16:21: ἡ γυνὴ ὅταν τίκτῃ 【λύπην】 ἔχει, ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα αὐτῆς· ὅταν δὲ γεννήσῃ τὸ παιδίον, οὐκέτι μνημονεύει τῆς θλίψεως διὰ τὴν χαρὰν ὅτι ἐγεννήθη ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
verses.HEB 12:11: πᾶσα μὲν παιδεία πρὸς μὲν τὸ παρὸν οὐ δοκεῖ χαρᾶς εἶναι ἀλλὰ 【λύπης,】 ὕστερον δὲ καρπὸν εἰρηνικὸν τοῖς δι’ αὐτῆς γεγυμνασμένοις ἀποδίδωσιν δικαιοσύνης.
verses.1PE 2:19: τοῦτο γὰρ χάρις εἰ διὰ συνείδησιν Θεοῦ ὑποφέρει τις 【λύπας】 πάσχων ἀδίκως.
verses.2CO 9:7: ἕκαστος καθὼς προῄρηται τῇ καρδίᾳ, μὴ ἐκ 【λύπης】 ἢ ἐξ ἀνάγκης· ἱλαρὸν γὰρ δότην ἀγαπᾷ ὁ Θεός.

benchmark_ref.detail: pain, grief, sorrow, affliction.

core_meaning_summary: Adverb of degree meaning exceedingly or intensely in its positive form, and even more, far more, or especially in its comparative form.

senses.definition: To an extraordinary degree or intense pitch, characterizing vehement shouting, astonishment, or rage.
senses.grammatical_frame: Positive adverb (περισσῶς) modifying verbs of vocalization or intense emotion (κράζω, ἐκπλήσσομαι, ἐμμαίνομαι).

senses.definition: To a greater or more abundant degree than others or than before; all the more or especially.
senses.grammatical_frame: Comparative adverb (περισσοτέρως) modifying finite verbs, infinitives, predicative nouns (ζηλωτής), or prepositional phrases (πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἐν κόποις, ἐν φυλακαῖς); once reinforced by μᾶλλον (2CO 7:13) and once contrasted with ἧσσον (2CO 12:15).

collocations_and_notes: All occurrences in MAT, MRK, and ACT use the positive adverb περισσῶς, whereas all occurrences in 2CO, GAL, PHP, 1TH, and HEB use the comparative form περισσοτέρως. In MAT 27:23 and MRK 15:14, περισσῶς ἔκραζον/ἔκραξαν describes the crowd shouting all the more vehemently in response to Pilate's question. Comparative περισσοτέρως appears pleonastically with μᾶλλον in 2CO 7:13 (περισσοτέρως μᾶλλον ἐχάρημεν), parallel with ὑπερβαλλόντως ("beyond measure") in 2CO 11:23, and contrasted with ἧσσον ("less") in 2CO 12:15.

verses.MAT 27:23: ὁ δὲ ἔφη Τί γὰρ κακὸν ἐποίησεν; οἱ δὲ 【περισσῶς】 ἔκραζον λέγοντες Σταυρωθήτω.
verses.MRK 10:26: οἱ δὲ 【περισσῶς】 ἐξεπλήσσοντο λέγοντες πρὸς ἑαυτούς Καὶ τίς δύναται σωθῆναι;
verses.MRK 15:14: ὁ δὲ Πειλᾶτος ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Τί γὰρ ἐποίησεν κακόν; οἱ δὲ 【περισσῶς】 ἔκραξαν Σταύρωσον αὐτόν.
verses.ACT 26:11: καὶ κατὰ πάσας τὰς συναγωγὰς πολλάκις τιμωρῶν αὐτοὺς ἠνάγκαζον βλασφημεῖν, 【περισσῶς】 τε ἐμμαινόμενος αὐτοῖς ἐδίωκον ἕως καὶ εἰς τὰς ἔξω πόλεις.
verses.2CO 1:12: Ἡ γὰρ καύχησις ἡμῶν αὕτη ἐστίν, τὸ μαρτύριον τῆς συνειδήσεως ἡμῶν, ὅτι ἐν ἁγιότητι καὶ εἰλικρινίᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ, οὐκ ἐν σοφίᾳ σαρκικῇ ἀλλ’ ἐν χάριτι Θεοῦ, ἀνεστράφημεν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, 【περισσοτέρως】 δὲ πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
verses.2CO 2:4: ἐκ γὰρ πολλῆς θλίψεως καὶ συνοχῆς καρδίας ἔγραψα ὑμῖν διὰ πολλῶν δακρύων, οὐχ ἵνα λυπηθῆτε, ἀλλὰ τὴν ἀγάπην ἵνα γνῶτε ἣν ἔχω 【περισσοτέρως】 εἰς ὑμᾶς.
verses.2CO 7:13: διὰ τοῦτο παρακεκλήμεθα. Ἐπὶ δὲ τῇ παρακλήσει ἡμῶν 【περισσοτέρως】 μᾶλλον ἐχάρημεν ἐπὶ τῇ χαρᾷ Τίτου, ὅτι ἀναπέπαυται τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ πάντων ὑμῶν·
verses.2CO 7:15: καὶ τὰ σπλάγχνα αὐτοῦ 【περισσοτέρως】 εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐστιν ἀναμιμνῃσκομένου τὴν πάντων ὑμῶν ὑπακοήν, ὡς μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου ἐδέξασθε αὐτόν.
verses.2CO 11:23: διάκονοι Χριστοῦ εἰσιν; παραφρονῶν λαλῶ, ὑπὲρ ἐγώ· ἐν κόποις 【περισσοτέρως,】 ἐν φυλακαῖς 【περισσοτέρως,】 ἐν πληγαῖς ὑπερβαλλόντως, ἐν θανάτοις πολλάκις.
verses.2CO 12:15: ἐγὼ δὲ ἥδιστα δαπανήσω καὶ ἐκδαπανηθήσομαι ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν. εἰ 【περισσοτέρως】 ὑμᾶς ἀγαπῶ, ἧσσον ἀγαπῶμαι;
verses.GAL 1:14: καὶ προέκοπτον ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ ὑπὲρ πολλοὺς συνηλικιώτας ἐν τῷ γένει μου, 【περισσοτέρως】 ζηλωτὴς ὑπάρχων τῶν πατρικῶν μου παραδόσεων.
verses.PHP 1:14: καὶ τοὺς πλείονας τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἐν Κυρίῳ πεποιθότας τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου 【περισσοτέρως】 τολμᾶν ἀφόβως τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ λαλεῖν.
verses.1TH 2:17: Ἡμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, ἀπορφανισθέντες ἀφ’ ὑμῶν πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας προσώπῳ οὐ καρδίᾳ, 【περισσοτέρως】 ἐσπουδάσαμεν τὸ πρόσωπον ὑμῶν ἰδεῖν ἐν πολλῇ ἐπιθυμίᾳ.
verses.HEB 2:1: Διὰ τοῦτο δεῖ 【περισσοτέρως】 προσέχειν ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἀκουσθεῖσιν, μή ποτε παραρυῶμεν.
verses.HEB 13:19: 【περισσοτέρως】 δὲ παρακαλῶ τοῦτο ποιῆσαι, ἵνα τάχειον ἀποκατασταθῶ ὑμῖν.

benchmark_ref.detail: greatly, exceedingly, abundantly, vehemently.

core_meaning_summary: Afflictions or hardships endured—especially physical suffering, persecution, or death—or strong inner impulses and desires oriented toward sin.

senses.definition: Hardships, afflictions, or painful experiences endured, including persecution and the suffering of death.
senses.grammatical_frame: Neuter noun, usually plural (singular only in HEB 2:9 with τοῦ θανάτου); frequently followed by τοῦ Χριστοῦ/αὐτοῦ or εἰς Χριστόν, governed by nouns/verbs of sharing (κοινωνία, κοινωνός, κοινωνέω) or endurance (ὑπομονή, ὑπομένω), or used with διά and ἐν.

senses.definition: Strong inner impulses, cravings, or desires associated with sinful conduct and the flesh.
senses.grammatical_frame: Neuter plural noun; modified by the genitive τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ('of sins') in ROM 7:5, or coordinated with ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις ('desires') after σύν in GAL 5:24.

collocations_and_notes: Appears in the plural (παθήματα) in 15 of 16 occurrences; the sole singular (τὸ πάθημα τοῦ θανάτου) occurs in HEB 2:9. When denoting affliction (sense 1a), it frequently collocates with τοῦ Χριστοῦ / αὐτοῦ / εἰς Χριστόν, with words of sharing or endurance (κοινωνός, κοινωνία, κοινωνέω, ὑπομονή, ὑπομένω), and with the cognate verb πάσχω (2CO 1:6), and is contrasted with δόξα ("glory") or παράκλησις ("comfort") (ROM 8:18; 2CO 1:5, 1:7; 1PE 1:11, 4:13, 5:1). In sense 1b, it is paired with ἐπιθυμίαι ("desires") in GAL 5:24 and linked to ἁμαρτίαι ("sins") in ROM 7:5.

verses.ROM 8:18: Λογίζομαι γὰρ ὅτι οὐκ ἄξια τὰ 【παθήματα】 τοῦ νῦν καιροῦ πρὸς τὴν μέλλουσαν δόξαν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι εἰς ἡμᾶς.
verses.2CO 1:5: ὅτι καθὼς περισσεύει τὰ 【παθήματα】 τοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς ἡμᾶς, οὕτως διὰ τοῦ Χριστοῦ περισσεύει καὶ ἡ παράκλησις ἡμῶν.
verses.2CO 1:6: εἴτε δὲ θλιβόμεθα, ὑπὲρ τῆς ὑμῶν παρακλήσεως καὶ σωτηρίας· εἴτε παρακαλούμεθα, ὑπὲρ τῆς ὑμῶν παρακλήσεως τῆς ἐνεργουμένης ἐν ὑπομονῇ τῶν αὐτῶν 【παθημάτων】 ὧν καὶ ἡμεῖς πάσχομεν.
verses.2CO 1:7: καὶ ἡ ἐλπὶς ἡμῶν βεβαία ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, εἰδότες ὅτι ὡς κοινωνοί ἐστε τῶν 【παθημάτων,】 οὕτως καὶ τῆς παρακλήσεως.
verses.PHP 3:10: τοῦ γνῶναι αὐτὸν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν τῆς ἀναστάσεως αὐτοῦ καὶ κοινωνίαν 【παθημάτων】 αὐτοῦ, συμμορφιζόμενος τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτοῦ,
verses.COL 1:24: Νῦν χαίρω ἐν τοῖς 【παθήμασιν】 ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, καὶ ἀνταναπληρῶ τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν θλίψεων τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου ὑπὲρ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ, ὅ ἐστιν ἡ ἐκκλησία,
verses.2TI 3:11: τοῖς διωγμοῖς, τοῖς 【παθήμασιν,】 οἷά μοι ἐγένετο ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ, ἐν Ἰκονίῳ, ἐν Λύστροις· οἵους διωγμοὺς ὑπήνεγκα, καὶ ἐκ πάντων με ἐρύσατο ὁ Κύριος.
verses.HEB 2:9: τὸν δὲ βραχύ τι παρ’ ἀγγέλους ἠλαττωμένον βλέπομεν Ἰησοῦν διὰ τὸ 【πάθημα】 τοῦ θανάτου δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφανωμένον, ὅπως χάριτι Θεοῦ ὑπὲρ παντὸς γεύσηται θανάτου.
verses.HEB 2:10: Ἔπρεπεν γὰρ αὐτῷ, δι’ ὃν τὰ πάντα καὶ δι’ οὗ τὰ πάντα, πολλοὺς υἱοὺς εἰς δόξαν ἀγαγόντα τὸν ἀρχηγὸν τῆς σωτηρίας αὐτῶν διὰ 【παθημάτων】 τελειῶσαι.
verses.HEB 10:32: Ἀναμιμνῄσκεσθε δὲ τὰς πρότερον ἡμέρας, ἐν αἷς φωτισθέντες πολλὴν ἄθλησιν ὑπεμείνατε 【παθημάτων,】
verses.1PE 1:11: ἐραυνῶντες εἰς τίνα ἢ ποῖον καιρὸν ἐδήλου τὸ ἐν αὐτοῖς Πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ προμαρτυρόμενον τὰ εἰς Χριστὸν 【παθήματα】 καὶ τὰς μετὰ ταῦτα δόξας·
verses.1PE 4:13: ἀλλὰ καθὸ κοινωνεῖτε τοῖς τοῦ Χριστοῦ 【παθήμασιν】 χαίρετε, ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ χαρῆτε ἀγαλλιώμενοι.
verses.1PE 5:1: Πρεσβυτέρους οὖν ἐν ὑμῖν παρακαλῶ ὁ συνπρεσβύτερος καὶ μάρτυς τῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ 【παθημάτων,】 ὁ καὶ τῆς μελλούσης ἀποκαλύπτεσθαι δόξης κοινωνός,
verses.1PE 5:9: ᾧ ἀντίστητε στερεοὶ τῇ πίστει, εἰδότες τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν 【παθημάτων】 τῇ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὑμῶν ἀδελφότητι ἐπιτελεῖσθαι.
verses.ROM 7:5: ὅτε γὰρ ἦμεν ἐν τῇ σαρκί, τὰ 【παθήματα】 τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν τὰ διὰ τοῦ νόμου ἐνηργεῖτο ἐν τοῖς μέλεσιν ἡμῶν εἰς τὸ καρποφορῆσαι τῷ θανάτῳ·
verses.GAL 5:24: οἱ δὲ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τὴν σάρκα ἐσταύρωσαν σὺν τοῖς 【παθήμασιν】 καὶ ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις.

benchmark_ref.detail: (a) suffering, affliction, (b) passion, emotion, (c) an undergoing, an enduring.

core_meaning_summary: To seize or arrest someone, catch prey, conceive offspring in the womb, or come alongside someone to help.

senses.definition: To lay hold of and apprehend a person by force or authority, typically to take into custody, bind, or bring to trial or harm.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active or middle verb taking a personal accusative object; passive with ὑπό + genitive indicating the arresting agents.

senses.definition: To capture or haul in fish or other prey during hunting or fishing.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active verb with an implied accusative object (attracted to dative in relative clause).

senses.definition: To become pregnant with or conceive a child in the womb (or, in the passive, for a child to be conceived).
senses.grammatical_frame: Active or middle verb used absolutely, with ἐν γαστρί, or with an accusative object (υἱόν); passive infinitive with the conceived child as accusative subject and ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ.

senses.definition: Figuratively, for an inward desire to conceive and generate an ensuing moral outcome, depicted through childbirth imagery.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active participle used absolutely with an abstract subject (ἐπιθυμία).

senses.definition: To join with and lend assistance to someone in carrying out a demanding task or shared endeavor.
senses.grammatical_frame: Middle verb taking a personal object in the dative.

collocations_and_notes: Distinct voice patterns correlate with sense: active (and once middle in ACT 26:21) or passive (ACT 23:27) with a personal accusative object expresses arrest/seizure; active/middle with ἐν γαστρί or ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ (or υἱόν as object) expresses biological conception; middle with a dative object (LUK 5:7, PHP 4:3) expresses lending aid. In JAS 1:15, συλλαβοῦσα pairs with τίκτει ("gives birth to") and ἀποκύει ("brings forth") in an extended birth metaphor. In arrest contexts, it frequently co-occurs with leading away (ἤγαγον), binding (ἔδησαν), or weapons (μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων).

verses.MAT 26:55: Ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς ὄχλοις Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων 【συλλαβεῖν】 με; καθ’ ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐκαθεζόμην διδάσκων, καὶ οὐκ ἐκρατήσατέ με.
verses.MRK 14:48: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων 【συλλαβεῖν】 με·
verses.LUK 22:54: 【Συλλαβόντες】 δὲ αὐτὸν ἤγαγον καὶ εἰσήγαγον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως· ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἠκολούθει μακρόθεν.
verses.JHN 18:12: Ἡ οὖν σπεῖρα καὶ ὁ χιλίαρχος καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται τῶν Ἰουδαίων 【συνέλαβον】 τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἔδησαν αὐτὸν,
verses.ACT 1:16: Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ἔδει πληρωθῆναι τὴν γραφὴν ἣν προεῖπεν τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον διὰ στόματος Δαυεὶδ περὶ Ἰούδα τοῦ γενομένου ὁδηγοῦ τοῖς 【συλλαβοῦσιν】 Ἰησοῦν,
verses.ACT 12:3: ἰδὼν δὲ ὅτι ἀρεστόν ἐστιν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις προσέθετο 【συλλαβεῖν】 καὶ Πέτρον, ἦσαν δὲ ἡμέραι τῶν ἀζύμων,
verses.ACT 23:27: Τὸν ἄνδρα τοῦτον 【συλλημφθέντα】 ὑπὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ μέλλοντα ἀναιρεῖσθαι ὑπ’ αὐτῶν ἐπιστὰς σὺν τῷ στρατεύματι ἐξειλάμην, μαθὼν ὅτι Ῥωμαῖός ἐστιν·
verses.ACT 26:21: ἕνεκα τούτων με Ἰουδαῖοι 【συλλαβόμενοι】 ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐπειρῶντο διαχειρίσασθαι.
verses.LUK 5:9: θάμβος γὰρ περιέσχεν αὐτὸν καὶ πάντας τοὺς σὺν αὐτῷ ἐπὶ τῇ ἄγρᾳ τῶν ἰχθύων ᾗ 【συνέλαβον,】
verses.LUK 1:24: Μετὰ δὲ ταύτας τὰς ἡμέρας 【συνέλαβεν】 Ἐλεισάβετ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ, καὶ περιέκρυβεν ἑαυτὴν μῆνας πέντε, λέγουσα
verses.LUK 1:31: καὶ ἰδοὺ 【συλλήμψῃ】 ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν, καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν.
verses.LUK 1:36: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἐλεισάβετ ἡ συγγενίς σου καὶ αὐτὴ 【συνείληφεν】 υἱὸν ἐν γήρει αὐτῆς, καὶ οὗτος μὴν ἕκτος ἐστὶν αὐτῇ τῇ καλουμένῃ στείρᾳ·
verses.LUK 2:21: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν ἡμέραι ὀκτὼ τοῦ περιτεμεῖν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦς, τὸ κληθὲν ὑπὸ τοῦ ἀγγέλου πρὸ τοῦ 【συλλημφθῆναι】 αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ.
verses.JAS 1:15: εἶτα ἡ ἐπιθυμία 【συλλαβοῦσα】 τίκτει ἁμαρτίαν, ἡ δὲ ἁμαρτία ἀποτελεσθεῖσα ἀποκύει θάνατον.
verses.LUK 5:7: καὶ κατένευσαν τοῖς μετόχοις ἐν τῷ ἑτέρῳ πλοίῳ τοῦ ἐλθόντας 【συλλαβέσθαι】 αὐτοῖς· καὶ ἦλθαν, καὶ ἔπλησαν ἀμφότερα τὰ πλοῖα ὥστε βυθίζεσθαι αὐτά.
verses.PHP 4:3: ναὶ ἐρωτῶ καὶ σέ, γνήσιε σύνζυγε, 【συνλαμβάνου】 αὐταῖς, αἵτινες ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ συνήθλησάν μοι μετὰ καὶ Κλήμεντος καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν συνεργῶν μου, ὧν τὰ ὀνόματα ἐν βίβλῳ ζωῆς.

benchmark_ref.detail: I seize, apprehend, assist, conceive, become pregnant.

core_meaning_summary: To summon the courage to act despite fear or risk, or to presume to do something bold or audacious.

senses.definition: To overcome fear, awe, or danger and summon the courage to perform an action; often negated when people shrink back from acting.
senses.grammatical_frame: Verb followed by a complementary infinitive, or participle accompanying a finite verb of action (MRK 15:43).

senses.definition: To have the audacity or presumption to cross a proper moral, social, or spiritual boundary (whether criticized in others or disavowed by the speaker).
senses.grammatical_frame: Verb followed by a complementary infinitive.

senses.definition: To act boldly, adopt a forceful stance against opponents, or speak with daring self-assertion.
senses.grammatical_frame: Infinitive with ἐπί + accusative indicating those confronted, or finite verb used absolutely or with ἐν + dative specifying the ground of boldness.

collocations_and_notes: Frequently negated (οὐδὲ ... τις, οὐδεὶς οὐκέτι, οὐκ, οὐ γάρ) to mark hesitation out of awe, fear, or restraint (MAT 22:46, MRK 12:34, LUK 20:40, JHN 21:12, ACT 5:13, ACT 7:32, ROM 15:18, 2CO 10:12, JUD 1:9). Often pairs with verbs of questioning (ἐπερωτάω, ἐξετάζω) or speaking (λαλέω, κρίσιν ἐπενεγκεῖν). In 2CO 10:2 it parallels θαρρῆσαι τῇ πεποιθήσει ("act boldly with confidence"), and in PHP 1:14 it collocates with πεποιθότας ("confident") and ἀφόβως ("fearlessly").

verses.MAT 22:46: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο ἀποκριθῆναι αὐτῷ λόγον, οὐδὲ 【ἐτόλμησέν】 τις ἀπ’ ἐκείνης τῆς ἡμέρας ἐπερωτῆσαι αὐτὸν οὐκέτι.
verses.MRK 12:34: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ὅτι νουνεχῶς ἀπεκρίθη, εἶπεν αὐτῷ Οὐ μακρὰν εἶ ἀπὸ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ. καὶ οὐδεὶς οὐκέτι 【ἐτόλμα】 αὐτὸν ἐπερωτῆσαι.
verses.MRK 15:43: ἐλθὼν Ἰωσὴφ ὁ ἀπὸ Ἀριμαθαίας, εὐσχήμων βουλευτής, ὃς καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν προσδεχόμενος τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ, 【τολμήσας】 εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς τὸν Πειλᾶτον καὶ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.JHN 21:12: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Δεῦτε ἀριστήσατε. οὐδεὶς 【ἐτόλμα】 τῶν μαθητῶν ἐξετάσαι αὐτόν Σὺ τίς εἶ; εἰδότες ὅτι ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν.
verses.ACT 5:13: τῶν δὲ λοιπῶν οὐδεὶς 【ἐτόλμα】 κολλᾶσθαι αὐτοῖς, ἀλλ’ ἐμεγάλυνεν αὐτοὺς ὁ λαός·
verses.ACT 7:32: Ἐγὼ ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πατέρων σου, ὁ Θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακώβ. ἔντρομος δὲ γενόμενος Μωϋσῆς οὐκ 【ἐτόλμα】 κατανοῆσαι.
verses.ROM 5:7: μόλις γὰρ ὑπὲρ δικαίου τις ἀποθανεῖται· ὑπὲρ γὰρ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ τάχα τις καὶ 【τολμᾷ】 ἀποθανεῖν·
verses.PHP 1:14: καὶ τοὺς πλείονας τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἐν Κυρίῳ πεποιθότας τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου περισσοτέρως 【τολμᾶν】 ἀφόβως τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ λαλεῖν.
verses.ROM 15:18: οὐ γὰρ 【τολμήσω】 τι λαλεῖν ὧν οὐ κατειργάσατο Χριστὸς δι’ ἐμοῦ εἰς ὑπακοὴν ἐθνῶν, λόγῳ καὶ ἔργῳ,
verses.1CO 6:1: 【Τολμᾷ】 τις ὑμῶν πρᾶγμα ἔχων πρὸς τὸν ἕτερον κρίνεσθαι ἐπὶ τῶν ἀδίκων, καὶ οὐχὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ἁγίων;
verses.2CO 10:12: Οὐ γὰρ 【τολμῶμεν】 ἐνκρῖναι ἢ συνκρῖναι ἑαυτούς τισιν τῶν ἑαυτοὺς συνιστανόντων· ἀλλὰ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἑαυτοὺς μετροῦντες καὶ συνκρίνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ἑαυτοῖς οὐ συνιᾶσιν.
verses.JUD 1:9: ὁ δὲ Μιχαὴλ ὁ ἀρχάγγελος, ὅτε τῷ διαβόλῳ διακρινόμενος διελέγετο περὶ τοῦ Μωϋσέως σώματος, οὐκ 【ἐτόλμησεν】 κρίσιν ἐπενεγκεῖν βλασφημίας, ἀλλὰ εἶπεν Ἐπιτιμήσαι σοι Κύριος.
verses.2CO 10:2: δέομαι δὲ τὸ μὴ παρὼν θαρρῆσαι τῇ πεποιθήσει ᾗ λογίζομαι 【τολμῆσαι】 ἐπί τινας τοὺς λογιζομένους ἡμᾶς ὡς κατὰ σάρκα περιπατοῦντας.
verses.2CO 11:21: κατὰ ἀτιμίαν λέγω, ὡς ὅτι ἡμεῖς ἠσθενήκαμεν. ἐν ᾧ δ’ ἄν τις 【τολμᾷ,】 ἐν ἀφροσύνῃ λέγω, 【τολμῶ】 κἀγώ.

benchmark_ref.detail: I dare, endure, am bold, have courage, make up the mind.

core_meaning_summary: To stay in a place or with someone for a time, continue an action, or persevere in a state, attitude, or teaching.

senses.definition: To stay or remain at a location or in someone's company for a period of time.
senses.grammatical_frame: Intransitive verb often accompanied by an accusative of time duration, an adverb of place, or prepositional phrases (ἐν + dative, παρά + dative, πρός + accusative).

senses.definition: To remain alive in bodily existence.
senses.grammatical_frame: Articular infinitive with a dative of sphere (τῇ σαρκί).

senses.definition: To continue doing an action persistently without stopping.
senses.grammatical_frame: Finite verb followed by a supplementary present participle.

senses.definition: To continue steadfastly or persist in an inner disposition, moral course, faith, or instruction.
senses.grammatical_frame: Verb (indicative, subjunctive, or imperative) taking a dative complement specifying the condition, practice, or teaching.

collocations_and_notes: Syntactic construction clearly distinguishes spatial/temporal remaining from behavioral/spiritual persistence: spatial uses take accusatives of duration (e.g., ἡμέρας τρεῖς/ἑπτά/δεκαπέντε, χρόνον τινά) and locative/associative expressions (αὐτοῦ, ἐν Ἐφέσῳ, παρ’ αὐτοῖς, πρὸς ὑμᾶς/αὐτόν); ongoing action takes a supplementary present participle (JHN 8:7, ACT 12:16); moral or spiritual persistence takes a dative complement (τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, τῇ χρηστότητι, τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ, τῇ πίστει, αὐτοῖς). In COL 1:23, it is reinforced by τεθεμελιωμένοι καὶ ἑδραῖοι καὶ μὴ μετακινούμενοι ("established, steadfast, and not shifting").

verses.ACT 10:48: προσέταξεν δὲ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ βαπτισθῆναι. τότε ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν 【ἐπιμεῖναι】 ἡμέρας τινάς.
verses.ACT 21:4: ἀνευρόντες δὲ τοὺς μαθητὰς 【ἐπεμείναμεν】 αὐτοῦ ἡμέρας ἑπτά· οἵτινες τῷ Παύλῳ ἔλεγον διὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος μὴ ἐπιβαίνειν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.
verses.ACT 21:10: 【Ἐπιμενόντων】 δὲ ἡμέρας πλείους κατῆλθέν τις ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας προφήτης ὀνόματι Ἄγαβος,
verses.ACT 28:12: καὶ καταχθέντες εἰς Συρακούσας 【ἐπεμείναμεν】 ἡμέρας τρεῖς,
verses.ACT 28:14: οὗ εὑρόντες ἀδελφοὺς παρεκλήθημεν παρ’ αὐτοῖς 【ἐπιμεῖναι】 ἡμέρας ἑπτά· καὶ οὕτως εἰς τὴν Ῥώμην ἤλθαμεν.
verses.1CO 16:7: οὐ θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς ἄρτι ἐν παρόδῳ ἰδεῖν· ἐλπίζω γὰρ χρόνον τινὰ 【ἐπιμεῖναι】 πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἐὰν ὁ Κύριος ἐπιτρέψῃ.
verses.1CO 16:8: 【ἐπιμενῶ】 δὲ ἐν Ἐφέσῳ ἕως τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς·
verses.GAL 1:18: Ἔπειτα μετὰ τρία ἔτη ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἱστορῆσαι Κηφᾶν, καὶ 【ἐπέμεινα】 πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡμέρας δεκαπέντε·
verses.PHP 1:24: τὸ δὲ 【ἐπιμένειν】 τῇ σαρκὶ ἀναγκαιότερον δι’ ὑμᾶς.
verses.JHN 8:7: ὡς δὲ 【ἐπέμενον】 ἐρωτῶντες αὐτόν, ἀνάκυψας εἶπε πρὸς αὐτοὺς, Ὁ ἀναμάρτητος ὑμῶν πρῶτος τὸν λίθον ἐπ’ αὐτῇ βαλέτω.
verses.ACT 12:16: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος 【ἐπέμενεν】 κρούων· ἀνοίξαντες δὲ εἶδαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξέστησαν.
verses.ROM 6:1: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν; 【ἐπιμένωμεν】 τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, ἵνα ἡ χάρις πλεονάσῃ;
verses.ROM 11:22: ἴδε οὖν χρηστότητα καὶ ἀποτομίαν Θεοῦ· ἐπὶ μὲν τοὺς πεσόντας ἀποτομία, ἐπὶ δὲ σὲ χρηστότης Θεοῦ, ἐὰν 【ἐπιμένῃς】 τῇ χρηστότητι, ἐπεὶ καὶ σὺ ἐκκοπήσῃ.
verses.ROM 11:23: κἀκεῖνοι δέ, ἐὰν μὴ 【ἐπιμένωσιν】 τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ, ἐνκεντρισθήσονται· δυνατὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ Θεὸς πάλιν ἐνκεντρίσαι αὐτούς.
verses.COL 1:23: εἴ γε 【ἐπιμένετε】 τῇ πίστει τεθεμελιωμένοι καὶ ἑδραῖοι καὶ μὴ μετακινούμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ εὐαγγελίου οὗ ἠκούσατε, τοῦ κηρυχθέντος ἐν πάσῃ κτίσει τῇ ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν, οὗ ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ Παῦλος διάκονος.

benchmark_ref.detail: (a) I remain, tarry, (b) I remain in, persist in.

core_meaning_summary: A hired laborer or artisan who works for pay, figuratively a minister or missionary, or a doer of a specified moral quality.

senses.definition: A person hired for manual, agricultural, or skilled trade work in exchange for wages or sustenance (including proverbial references to such workers applied to Christian ministers).
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun used alone, with a prepositional modifier (περὶ τὰ τοιαῦτα), or with an attributive participle (τῶν ἀμησάντων).

senses.definition: Figuratively, a person engaged in spiritual mission, teaching, or ministry (depicted either as a harvester sent by God or characterized by adjectives as faithful or deceitful).
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun used in harvest metaphors or modified by evaluative adjectives (δόλιοι, κακούς, ἀνεπαίσχυντον).

senses.definition: A practitioner or doer of a particular kind of moral behavior.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun governing an abstract noun in the genitive (ἀδικίας).

collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired with terms for remuneration or support: μισθός ("wages" in MAT 20:8, LUK 10:7, 1TI 5:18, JAS 5:4), μισθόομαι ("hire" in MAT 20:1), δηναρίου ("a denarius" in MAT 20:2), and τροφή ("food" in MAT 10:10). The saying ἄξιος (γὰρ) ὁ ἐργάτης τοῦ μισθοῦ/τῆς τροφῆς αὐτοῦ appears in MAT 10:10, LUK 10:7, and 1TI 5:18. In harvest sayings (MAT 9:37–38, LUK 10:2), it pairs with θερισμός ("harvest"). In epistles, evaluative modifiers distinguish faithful workers (ἀνεπαίσχυντον in 2TI 2:15) from harmful ones (δόλιοι in 2CO 11:13, κακούς in PHP 3:2).

verses.MAT 10:10: μὴ πήραν εἰς ὁδὸν μηδὲ δύο χιτῶνας μηδὲ ὑποδήματα μηδὲ ῥάβδον· ἄξιος γὰρ ὁ 【ἐργάτης】 τῆς τροφῆς αὐτοῦ.
verses.MAT 20:1: Ὁμοία γάρ ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἀνθρώπῳ οἰκοδεσπότῃ, ὅστις ἐξῆλθεν ἅμα πρωῒ μισθώσασθαι 【ἐργάτας】 εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα αὐτοῦ.

verses.MAT 20:8: ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης λέγει ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος τῷ ἐπιτρόπῳ αὐτοῦ Κάλεσον τοὺς 【ἐργάτας】 καὶ ἀπόδος τὸν μισθόν, ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῶν ἐσχάτων ἕως τῶν πρώτων.
verses.LUK 10:7: ἐν αὐτῇ δὲ τῇ οἰκίᾳ μένετε, ἔσθοντες καὶ πίνοντες τὰ παρ’ αὐτῶν· ἄξιος γὰρ ὁ 【ἐργάτης】 τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ. μὴ μεταβαίνετε ἐξ οἰκίας εἰς οἰκίαν.
verses.ACT 19:25: οὓς συναθροίσας καὶ τοὺς περὶ τὰ τοιαῦτα 【ἐργάτας】 εἶπεν Ἄνδρες, ἐπίστασθε ὅτι ἐκ ταύτης τῆς ἐργασίας ἡ εὐπορία ἡμῖν ἐστιν,

verses.JAS 5:4: ἰδοὺ ὁ μισθὸς τῶν 【ἐργατῶν】 τῶν ἀμησάντων τὰς χώρας ὑμῶν ὁ ἀφυστερημένος ἀφ’ ὑμῶν κράζει, καὶ αἱ βοαὶ τῶν θερισάντων εἰς τὰ ὦτα Κυρίου Σαβαὼθ εἰσελήλυθαν.
verses.MAT 9:37: τότε λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Ὁ μὲν θερισμὸς πολύς, οἱ δὲ 【ἐργάται】 ὀλίγοι·

verses.LUK 10:2: ἔλεγεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Ὁ μὲν θερισμὸς πολύς, οἱ δὲ 【ἐργάται】 ὀλίγοι· δεήθητε οὖν τοῦ Κυρίου τοῦ θερισμοῦ ὅπως 【ἐργάτας】 ἐκβάλῃ εἰς τὸν θερισμὸν αὐτοῦ.

verses.PHP 3:2: Βλέπετε τοὺς κύνας, βλέπετε τοὺς κακοὺς 【ἐργάτας,】 βλέπετε τὴν κατατομήν.
verses.2TI 2:15: σπούδασον σεαυτὸν δόκιμον παραστῆσαι τῷ Θεῷ, 【ἐργάτην】 ἀνεπαίσχυντον, ὀρθοτομοῦντα τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας.

benchmark_ref.detail: a field-laborer; then: a laborer, workman in general.

core_meaning_summary: To lack, run short of, experience scarcity, or fall short of a standard or comparison.

senses.definition: To be missing, be without, or run out of something needed or expected.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active (intransitive, with accusative or genitive of the thing lacking, or in a genitive absolute)

senses.definition: To experience material want, scarcity, or poverty.
senses.grammatical_frame: Middle or passive, absolute

senses.definition: To fall short of, be deficient in, or fail to attain a spiritual gift, promise, or divine standard.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active (absolute or with ἀπό + genitive) or middle/passive (with genitive or ἐν + dative)

senses.definition: To be inferior to, rank behind, or stand at a disadvantage compared to another.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active (with accusative of respect and genitive of comparison) or middle/passive (absolute)

collocations_and_notes: Frequently contrasted with περισσεύω ("to have an abundance/advantage", 1CO 8:8, 1CO 12:24, PHP 4:12) and paired with verbs of hardship such as θλίβομαι, κακουχέομαι, and πεινάω (PHP 4:12, HEB 11:37). Takes a genitive of comparison when expressing rank relative to others (2CO 11:5, 2CO 12:11), a genitive of the thing lacking (LUK 22:35, JHN 2:3, ROM 3:23), or ἀπό + genitive (HEB 12:15). In MRK 10:21 the thing lacking (ἕν) stands as subject with the person in the accusative (σε). In 2CO 11:9 it appears alongside the cognate noun ὑστέρημα.

verses.MAT 19:20: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ νεανίσκος Ταῦτα πάντα ἐφύλαξα· τί ἔτι 【ὑστερῶ;】

core_meaning_summary: An enclitic focusing particle that emphasizes, restricts, or adds pointed force to the preceding word, clause, or conjunction ("at least," "indeed," "even").

senses.definition: Restricts attention to a minimal sufficient reason or partial concession in contrast to a broader statement.
senses.grammatical_frame: enclitic particle following a preposition (διά) or adversative conjunction (ἀλλά)

senses.definition: Adds emphatic or assertive weight to a contrast, addition, relative clause, direct question, or wish.
senses.grammatical_frame: enclitic particle following conjunctions (ἀλλά, καί, ἀλλὰ μὲν οὖν), interrogatives (ἆρα), optative particles (ὄφελον), or relative pronouns (ὅς)

senses.definition: Highlights a conditional clause as an essential qualification, a minimal possibility, or a condition treated as presumed true.
senses.grammatical_frame: enclitic particle following a conditional conjunction (εἰ or εἰ ἄρα)

collocations_and_notes: Always postpositive (placed after the word or phrase it highlights). Frequent combinations include εἴ γε (marking an assumed or crucial condition, 2CO 5:3, GAL 3:4, EPH 3:2, EPH 4:21, COL 1:23), εἰ ἄρα γε (ACT 17:27), διά γε (LUK 11:8, LUK 18:5), ἀλλά γε (LUK 24:21, 1CO 9:2), ἀλλὰ μὲν οὖν γε (PHP 3:8), καί γε (ACT 17:27), ἆρά γε (ACT 8:30), ὄφελόν γε (1CO 4:8), and ὅς γε (ROM 8:32). Often reinforces an accompanying καί (LUK 24:21, 2CO 5:3, GAL 3:4, PHP 3:8).

verses.LUK 11:8: λέγω ὑμῖν, εἰ καὶ οὐ δώσει αὐτῷ ἀναστὰς διὰ τὸ εἶναι φίλον αὐτοῦ, διά 【γε】 τὴν ἀναιδίαν αὐτοῦ ἐγερθεὶς δώσει αὐτῷ ὅσων χρῄζει.

verses.1CO 9:2: εἰ ἄλλοις οὐκ εἰμὶ ἀπόστολος, ἀλλά 【γε】 ὑμῖν εἰμι· ἡ γὰρ σφραγίς μου τῆς ἀποστολῆς ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν Κυρίῳ.
verses.LUK 24:21: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἠλπίζομεν ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ μέλλων λυτροῦσθαι τὸν Ἰσραήλ· ἀλλά 【γε】 καὶ σὺν πᾶσιν τούτοις τρίτην ταύτην ἡμέραν ἄγει ἀφ’ οὗ ταῦτα ἐγένετο.
verses.ACT 8:30: προσδραμὼν δὲ ὁ Φίλιππος ἤκουσεν αὐτοῦ ἀναγινώσκοντος Ἡσαΐαν τὸν προφήτην, καὶ εἶπεν Ἆρά 【γε】 γινώσκεις ἃ ἀναγινώσκεις;
verses.ACT 17:27: ζητεῖν τὸν Θεὸν, εἰ ἄρα 【γε】 ψηλαφήσειαν αὐτὸν καὶ εὕροιεν, καί 【γε】 οὐ μακρὰν ἀπὸ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου ἡμῶν ὑπάρχοντα.
verses.ROM 8:32: ὅς 【γε】 τοῦ ἰδίου Υἱοῦ οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν πάντων παρέδωκεν αὐτόν, πῶς οὐχὶ καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ἡμῖν χαρίσεται;

verses.PHP 3:8: ἀλλὰ μὲν οὖν 【γε】 καὶ ἡγοῦμαι πάντα ζημίαν εἶναι διὰ τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου μου, δι’ ὃν τὰ πάντα ἐζημιώθην, καὶ ἡγοῦμαι σκύβαλα ἵνα Χριστὸν κερδήσω
verses.2CO 5:3: εἴ 【γε】 καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι οὐ γυμνοὶ εὑρεθησόμεθα.
verses.GAL 3:4: τοσαῦτα ἐπάθετε εἰκῇ; εἴ 【γε】 καὶ εἰκῇ.
verses.EPH 3:2: εἴ 【γε】 ἠκούσατε τὴν οἰκονομίαν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ Θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς,
verses.EPH 4:21: εἴ 【γε】 αὐτὸν ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ ἐδιδάχθητε, καθώς ἐστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ,
verses.COL 1:23: εἴ 【γε】 ἐπιμένετε τῇ πίστει τεθεμελιωμένοι καὶ ἑδραῖοι καὶ μὴ μετακινούμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ εὐαγγελίου οὗ ἠκούσατε, τοῦ κηρυχθέντος ἐν πάσῃ κτίσει τῇ ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν, οὗ ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ Παῦλος διάκονος.

benchmark_ref.detail: an enclitic, emphasizing particle: at least, indeed, really, but generally too subtle to be represented in English.

core_meaning_summary: Grateful acknowledgment, thankfulness, or a verbal/liturgical expression of thanks offered to a benefactor or to God.

senses.definition: An attitude, disposition, or expression of gratitude and appreciation directed toward a human ruler or toward God.
senses.grammatical_frame: feminine noun, singular or plural, often with μετά, ἐν, or dative indirect object (τῷ Θεῷ)

senses.definition: A spoken prayer, blessing, or liturgical ascription of thanks offered to God in worship, petition, or over food.
senses.grammatical_frame: feminine noun, singular or plural, paired with prayer or doxological nouns or governed by μετά / ἐν / ἐπί

collocations_and_notes: Frequently appears in prepositional phrases with μετά (ACT 24:3, PHP 4:6, 1TI 4:3, 1TI 4:4) or ἐν (COL 2:7, COL 4:2), and with the dative recipient τῷ Θεῷ (2CO 9:11, 2CO 9:12, 1TH 3:9; compare REV 4:9, REV 7:12). Often paired with terms for prayer such as προσευχή, δέησις, and ἔντευξις (PHP 4:6, COL 4:2, 1TI 2:1) or with doxological terms like δόξα, τιμή, and εὐλογία (REV 4:9, REV 7:12). Uses in prayer over food (1TI 4:3, 1TI 4:4) and in petition (PHP 4:6, COL 4:2) bridge inward gratefulness and spoken expressions of thanks.

core_meaning_summary: To lay hold of, overtake, or catch someone or something; to attain a goal; or, especially in the middle voice, to grasp mentally and perceive.

senses.definition: To seize, overtake, or come upon someone suddenly or overwhelmingly, whether by an external force, darkness, a day of judgment, or Christ.
senses.grammatical_frame: active or passive transitive verb with personal or concrete direct object (or passive with ὑπό + agent)

senses.definition: To catch or apprehend someone in the act of wrongdoing.
senses.grammatical_frame: passive verb with prepositional phrase (ἐν μοιχείᾳ) or participle/adverbial modifier (ἐπαυτοφώρῳ μοιχευομένη)

senses.definition: To reach, win, or successfully attain a sought-after goal or prize, often in athletic or pursuit imagery.
senses.grammatical_frame: active verb, used either transitively with an abstract object (δικαιοσύνην) or absolutely in contexts of running (τρέχω) or pursuing (διώκω)

senses.definition: To grasp mentally, recognize, ascertain, or comprehend a fact or dimension.
senses.grammatical_frame: middle verb taking a ὅτι clause, an accusative-infinitive clause, or an indirect question (τί ...)

collocations_and_notes: Shows clear voice patterns: the middle voice regularly denotes mental perception or grasping (ACT 4:13, ACT 10:34, ACT 25:25, EPH 3:18), whereas active and passive forms denote physically seizing, catching, overtaking, or attaining a goal (MRK 9:18, JHN 8:3, JHN 8:4, JHN 12:35, ROM 9:30, 1CO 9:24, PHP 3:12, PHP 3:13, 1TH 5:4). In PHP 3:12, the active (καταλάβω) and passive (κατελήμφθην ὑπὸ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ) are juxtaposed in the same sentence to contrast Paul's ongoing pursuit with Christ's prior seizure of him. In JHN 1:5, the active verb with ἡ σκοτία ("the darkness") as subject is contextually ambiguous between "overtake/overcome" (as in JHN 12:35) and "comprehend/grasp" (sense 1d).

core_meaning_summary: To feed to the full or, in the passive, to eat one's fill and have hunger or deep desire satisfied.

senses.definition: To provide enough food for people so that their hunger is completely satisfied.
senses.grammatical_frame: active transitive verb with accusative of person and optional genitive of food (ἄρτων)

senses.definition: To eat until full, be well fed, or have one's appetite satisfied (used of humans and scavenging birds).
senses.grammatical_frame: passive verb, often coordinated with ἐσθίω or contrasted with πεινάω, occasionally with ἀπό or ἐκ + genitive of the food source

senses.definition: To have a deep moral or spiritual longing completely fulfilled, expressed under the metaphor of hunger and thirst.
senses.grammatical_frame: passive verb predicated of those who hunger and thirst for righteousness (οἱ πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες τὴν δικαιοσύνην)

collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired with ἐσθίω ("eat") in narrative accounts of miraculous feedings (MAT 14:20, MAT 15:37, MRK 6:42, MRK 8:8, LUK 9:17, JHN 6:26) and contrasted directly with πεινάω ("be hungry": MAT 5:6, LUK 6:21, PHP 4:12). In LUK 6:21, the promise to "those who hunger now" parallels beatitudes about weeping, pointing primarily to literal hunger reversed by God's provision while also resonating with MAT 5:6. Source of food in passive constructions can be marked by ἀπό (LUK 16:21) or ἐκ (REV 19:21).

core_meaning_summary: Inner thought, reasoning, or questioning of the mind or heart, as well as interpersonal argument or dispute.

senses.definition: Inward thought, reasoning, deliberation, or intention occurring within a person's heart or mind, often hidden from other humans and judged morally.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun (usually plural), frequently modified by τῆς καρδίας or possessive genitives, or paired with moral adjectives (πονηροί, κακοί, μάταιοι).

senses.definition: Troubled questioning or doubt arising within a person's heart in response to distress or disbelief.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine plural subject with verb of arising (ἀναβαίνουσιν) + ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ, parallel to τεταραγμένοι ('troubled').

senses.definition: Dispute, argument, or contentious opinion among people.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun (singular or plural), used with ἐν αὐτοῖς introducing an indirect question (LUK 9:46), in genitive depending on διακρίσεις (ROM 14:1), or after χωρίς paired with words for grumbling or anger (PHP 2:14, 1TI 2:8).

collocations_and_notes: Strongly associated with the 'heart' (καρδία) as the inner seat of thought (MAT 15:19, MRK 7:21, LUK 2:35, LUK 5:22, LUK 9:47, LUK 24:38, ROM 1:21). Often qualified negatively as πονηροί ('evil', MAT 15:19, JAS 2:4), κακοί ('bad', MRK 7:21), or μάταιοι ('futile', 1CO 3:20; cf. ἐματαιώθησαν in ROM 1:21). Note the overlap between 1a and 1c in LUK 9:46–47, where an interpersonal argument among the disciples (9:46) is referred to as 'the reasoning of their heart' (9:47). Paired with γογγυσμῶν ('grumblings', PHP 2:14) and ὀργῆς ('anger', 1TI 2:8).

core_meaning_summary: Qualitative relative or exclamative pronoun/adjective indicating the kind, character, or degree of someone or something ('such as', 'of what sort').

senses.definition: Of such a kind, character, or magnitude as; introducing a qualitative comparison or characterization relative to an antecedent or correlative demonstrative.
senses.grammatical_frame: Relative qualitative adjective/pronoun agreeing in gender and number with its referent or antecedent, often correlated with τοιοῦτος, οὕτως, or ὁ αὐτός.

senses.definition: What kind of or how great, expressing character or intensity in an indirect question or exclamation.
senses.grammatical_frame: Qualitative adjective/pronoun in indirect question after οἴδατε (1TH 1:5) or modifying a noun (οἵους διωγμούς, 2TI 3:11).

senses.definition: Used in the negated neuter phrase οὐχ οἷον ὅτι to reject a potential inference ('not as though', 'it is not the case that').
senses.grammatical_frame: Neuter singular nominative/adverbial pronoun in the fixed phrase οὐχ οἷον + ὅτι-clause.

collocations_and_notes: Commonly correlates with demonstratives or adverbs of manner such as τοιοῦτος (MRK 13:19, 1CO 15:48, 2CO 10:11), οὕτως (MRK 9:3), or ὁ αὐτός (PHP 1:30). Frequently introduces hyperbolic or superlative comparisons of unprecedented scale (οἷα/οἷος οὐ γέγονεν/οὐκ ἐγένετο in MAT 24:21, MRK 13:19, REV 16:18). The negated neuter construction οὐχ οἷον ὅτι appears once (ROM 9:6) as a clause-level disclaimer.

verses.2CO 12:20: φοβοῦμαι γὰρ μή πως ἐλθὼν οὐχ 【οἵους】 θέλω εὕρω ὑμᾶς, κἀγὼ εὑρεθῶ ὑμῖν 【οἷον】 οὐ θέλετε, μή πως ἔρις, ζῆλος, θυμοί, ἐριθεῖαι, καταλαλιαί, ψιθυρισμοί, φυσιώσεις, ἀκαταστασίαι·

verses.2TI 3:11: τοῖς διωγμοῖς, τοῖς παθήμασιν, 【οἷά】 μοι ἐγένετο ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ, ἐν Ἰκονίῳ, ἐν Λύστροις· 【οἵους】 διωγμοὺς ὑπήνεγκα, καὶ ἐκ πάντων με ἐρύσατο ὁ Κύριος.
verses.REV 16:18: καὶ ἐγένοντο ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί, καὶ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας, 【οἷος】 οὐκ ἐγένετο ἀφ’ οὗ ἄνθρωπος ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τηλικοῦτος σεισμὸς οὕτω μέγας.
verses.1TH 1:5: ὅτι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐγενήθη εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν λόγῳ μόνον, ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν δυνάμει καὶ ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ πληροφορίᾳ πολλῇ, καθὼς οἴδατε 【οἷοι】 ἐγενήθημεν ἐν ὑμῖν δι’ ὑμᾶς.
verses.ROM 9:6: Οὐχ 【οἷον】 δὲ ὅτι ἐκπέπτωκεν ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ. οὐ γὰρ πάντες οἱ ἐξ Ἰσραήλ, οὗτοι Ἰσραήλ·

benchmark_ref.detail: of what kind, such as.

core_meaning_summary: To look forward to something with expectation, or to welcome and accept a person, offer, or circumstance.

senses.definition: To wait eagerly and expectantly for the arrival or realization of someone or something promised or anticipated.
senses.grammatical_frame: middle/deponent verb + accusative object (thing or person); occasionally with indirect question or relative pronoun referencing an anticipated event

senses.definition: To welcome a person hospitably into one's company, household, or community fellowship.
senses.grammatical_frame: middle/deponent verb + accusative personal object (often modified by ἐν Κυρίῳ)

senses.definition: To accept or consent to an offered outcome or difficult treatment without refusal or resistance.
senses.grammatical_frame: middle/deponent verb + accusative abstract noun (with negation in HEB 11:35)

collocations_and_notes: Frequently takes accusative objects denoting eschatological or promised realities (the kingdom of God, consolation of Israel, redemption of Jerusalem, blessed hope, mercy) in expectant contexts. In hospitable contexts it pairs with eating together (LUK 15:2) or receiving someone 'in the Lord' (ROM 16:2, PHP 2:29), and in HEB 10:34 it co-occurs with 'with joy' (μετὰ χαρᾶς) to express willing endurance of loss.

verses.MRK 15:43: ἐλθὼν Ἰωσὴφ ὁ ἀπὸ Ἀριμαθαίας, εὐσχήμων βουλευτής, ὃς καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν 【προσδεχόμενος】 τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ, τολμήσας εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς τὸν Πειλᾶτον καὶ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.LUK 2:25: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος ἦν ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ᾧ ὄνομα Συμεών, καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος δίκαιος καὶ εὐλαβής, 【προσδεχόμενος】 παράκλησιν τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, καὶ Πνεῦμα ἦν Ἅγιον ἐπ’ αὐτόν·
verses.LUK 2:38: καὶ αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐπιστᾶσα ἀνθωμολογεῖτο τῷ Θεῷ καὶ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ πᾶσιν τοῖς 【προσδεχομένοις】 λύτρωσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
verses.LUK 12:36: καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅμοιοι ἀνθρώποις 【προσδεχομένοις】 τὸν κύριον ἑαυτῶν πότε ἀναλύσῃ ἐκ τῶν γάμων, ἵνα ἐλθόντος καὶ κρούσαντος εὐθέως ἀνοίξωσιν αὐτῷ.
verses.LUK 23:51: —οὗτος οὐκ ἦν συνκατατεθειμένος τῇ βουλῇ καὶ τῇ πράξει αὐτῶν,— ἀπὸ Ἀριμαθαίας πόλεως τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ὃς 【προσεδέχετο】 τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ,
verses.ACT 23:21: σὺ οὖν μὴ πεισθῇς αὐτοῖς· ἐνεδρεύουσιν γὰρ αὐτὸν ἐξ αὐτῶν ἄνδρες πλείους τεσσεράκοντα, οἵτινες ἀνεθεμάτισαν ἑαυτοὺς μήτε φαγεῖν μήτε πιεῖν ἕως οὗ ἀνέλωσιν αὐτόν, καὶ νῦν εἰσιν ἕτοιμοι 【προσδεχόμενοι】 τὴν ἀπὸ σοῦ ἐπαγγελίαν.
verses.ACT 24:15: ἐλπίδα ἔχων εἰς τὸν Θεόν, ἣν καὶ αὐτοὶ οὗτοι 【προσδέχονται,】 ἀνάστασιν μέλλειν ἔσεσθαι δικαίων τε καὶ ἀδίκων.
verses.TIT 2:13: 【προσδεχόμενοι】 τὴν μακαρίαν ἐλπίδα καὶ ἐπιφάνειαν τῆς δόξης τοῦ μεγάλου Θεοῦ καὶ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ,
verses.JUD 1:21: ἑαυτοὺς ἐν ἀγάπῃ Θεοῦ τηρήσατε, 【προσδεχόμενοι】 τὸ ἔλεος τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.LUK 15:2: καὶ διεγόγγυζον οἵ τε Φαρισαῖοι καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς λέγοντες ὅτι Οὗτος ἁμαρτωλοὺς 【προσδέχεται】 καὶ συνεσθίει αὐτοῖς.
verses.ROM 16:2: ἵνα αὐτὴν 【προσδέξησθε】 ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀξίως τῶν ἁγίων, καὶ παραστῆτε αὐτῇ ἐν ᾧ ἂν ὑμῶν χρῄζῃ πράγματι· καὶ γὰρ αὐτὴ προστάτις πολλῶν ἐγενήθη καὶ ἐμοῦ αὐτοῦ.
verses.PHP 2:29: 【προσδέχεσθε】 οὖν αὐτὸν ἐν Κυρίῳ μετὰ πάσης χαρᾶς, καὶ τοὺς τοιούτους ἐντίμους ἔχετε,
verses.HEB 10:34: καὶ γὰρ τοῖς δεσμίοις συνεπαθήσατε, καὶ τὴν ἁρπαγὴν τῶν ὑπαρχόντων ὑμῶν μετὰ χαρᾶς 【προσεδέξασθε,】 γινώσκοντες ἔχειν ἑαυτοὺς κρείσσονα ὕπαρξιν καὶ μένουσαν.
verses.HEB 11:35: ἔλαβον γυναῖκες ἐξ ἀναστάσεως τοὺς νεκροὺς αὐτῶν· ἄλλοι δὲ ἐτυμπανίσθησαν, οὐ 【προσδεξάμενοι】 τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν, ἵνα κρείττονος ἀναστάσεως τύχωσιν·

benchmark_ref.detail: (a) I await, expect, (b) I receive, welcome (originally: to my house), (c) I accept.

core_meaning_summary: To bring down or lower in elevation, social standing, pride, or material circumstances, either voluntarily or through outside action.

senses.definition: To reduce the physical height of raised landforms so that terrain becomes level.
senses.grammatical_frame: passive verb with inanimate geographical subjects (mountain and hill)

senses.definition: To lower oneself voluntarily in status, self-importance, or pretension, adopting an attitude of submission or modest service.
senses.grammatical_frame: active verb + reflexive pronoun (ἑαυτόν / ἐμαυτόν), or passive imperative with middle/reflexive force (often with ἐνώπιον or ὑπό + accusative)

senses.definition: To be brought down in standing or humbled by God or another agent, especially in reversal of self-exaltation or failure.
senses.grammatical_frame: passive future verb (with personal subject) or active transitive verb + personal object

senses.definition: To experience lowly, straitened, or needy material circumstances.
senses.grammatical_frame: passive/middle infinitive contrasted with περισσεύειν ('have abundance')

collocations_and_notes: Repeatedly paired as an antonym with ὑψόω ('exalt/lift up') in proverbial reversals (MAT 23:12, LUK 14:11, LUK 18:14) and exhortations (2CO 11:7, JAS 4:10, 1PE 5:6). Note the voice distinction: active forms consistently take an explicit object (most often a reflexive pronoun for voluntary self-lowering, or a personal object in 2CO 12:21 for being humbled by God), whereas passive imperatives (JAS 4:10, 1PE 5:6) function reflexively/middle-like as calls to willing submission.

verses.LUK 3:5: πᾶσα φάραγξ πληρωθήσεται καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ βουνὸς 【ταπεινωθήσεται,】 καὶ ἔσται τὰ σκολιὰ εἰς εὐθείας καὶ αἱ τραχεῖαι εἰς ὁδοὺς λείας·
verses.MAT 18:4: ὅστις οὖν 【ταπεινώσει】 ἑαυτὸν ὡς τὸ παιδίον τοῦτο, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μείζων ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν.
verses.MAT 23:12: Ὅστις δὲ ὑψώσει ἑαυτὸν 【ταπεινωθήσεται,】 καὶ ὅστις 【ταπεινώσει】 ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται.
verses.LUK 14:11: ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὑψῶν ἑαυτὸν 【ταπεινωθήσεται,】 καὶ ὁ 【ταπεινῶν】 ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται.
verses.LUK 18:14: λέγω ὑμῖν, κατέβη οὗτος δεδικαιωμένος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ παρ’ ἐκεῖνον· ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὑψῶν ἑαυτὸν 【ταπεινωθήσεται,】 ὁ δὲ 【ταπεινῶν】 ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται.
verses.2CO 11:7: Ἢ ἁμαρτίαν ἐποίησα ἐμαυτὸν 【ταπεινῶν】 ἵνα ὑμεῖς ὑψωθῆτε, ὅτι δωρεὰν τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ εὐαγγέλιον εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν;
verses.PHP 2:8: 【ἐταπείνωσεν】 ἑαυτὸν γενόμενος ὑπήκοος μέχρι θανάτου, θανάτου δὲ σταυροῦ.
verses.1PE 5:6: 【Ταπεινώθητε】 οὖν ὑπὸ τὴν κραταιὰν χεῖρα τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἵνα ὑμᾶς ὑψώσῃ ἐν καιρῷ,
verses.2CO 12:21: μὴ πάλιν ἐλθόντος μου 【ταπεινώσῃ】 με ὁ Θεός μου πρὸς ὑμᾶς, καὶ πενθήσω πολλοὺς τῶν προημαρτηκότων καὶ μὴ μετανοησάντων ἐπὶ τῇ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ καὶ πορνείᾳ καὶ ἀσελγείᾳ ᾗ ἔπραξαν.
verses.PHP 4:12: οἶδα καὶ 【ταπεινοῦσθαι,】 οἶδα καὶ περισσεύειν· ἐν παντὶ καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν μεμύημαι, καὶ χορτάζεσθαι καὶ πεινᾶν, καὶ περισσεύειν καὶ ὑστερεῖσθαι.

benchmark_ref.detail: I make or bring low, humble, humiliate; pass: I am humbled.

core_meaning_summary: A visible mark, sculpted representation, guiding design, written form, prefiguring counterpart, or behavioral model.

senses.definition: A physical impression or scar left behind in a surface by an object.
senses.grammatical_frame: noun + genitive of the object leaving the mark (τῶν ἥλων)

senses.definition: A manufactured physical figure or image crafted for religious veneration.
senses.grammatical_frame: plural noun as object of ποιέω ('make') with purpose infinitive προσκυνεῖν ('worship')

senses.definition: A revealed design, structural blueprint, or standard form to which construction or instruction conforms.
senses.grammatical_frame: noun governed by κατά + accusative (construction blueprint) or modified by genitive διδαχῆς ('standard of teaching')

senses.definition: The form, wording, or general contents of a written letter.
senses.grammatical_frame: accusative noun with demonstrative τοῦτον as object of ἔχουσαν modifying ἐπιστολήν

senses.definition: A historical person or past event serving as a prefiguring counterpart or cautionary lesson for later people.
senses.grammatical_frame: predicate nominative with ἐστίν or γίνομαι + genitive of reference

senses.definition: A person or community whose conduct serves as a model or standard for others to imitate.
senses.grammatical_frame: predicate or appositional noun with γίνομαι, ἔχω, δίδωμι, or παρέχομαι, often with dative or genitive of the observers/virtues

collocations_and_notes: In pattern/design contexts it co-occurs with κατὰ τόν ('according to the pattern', ACT 7:44, HEB 8:5). In moral exhortation it regularly takes a genitive of the group or virtues exemplified or appears with verbs of imitation (συνμιμηταί in PHP 3:17; μιμεῖσθαι in 2TH 3:9). In ACT 23:25, 'having this form/tenor' introduces the verbatim or summary text of an official letter.

verses.JHN 20:25: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ ἄλλοι μαθηταί Ἑωράκαμεν τὸν Κύριον. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐὰν μὴ ἴδω ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ τὸν 【τύπον】 τῶν ἥλων καὶ βάλω τὸν δάκτυλόν μου εἰς τὸν τόπον τῶν ἥλων καὶ βάλω μου τὴν χεῖρα εἰς τὴν πλευρὰν αὐτοῦ, οὐ μὴ πιστεύσω.
verses.ACT 7:43: καὶ ἀνελάβετε τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ Μολὸχ καὶ τὸ ἄστρον τοῦ θεοῦ Ῥομφά, τοὺς 【τύπους】 οὓς ἐποιήσατε προσκυνεῖν αὐτοῖς; καὶ μετοικιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐπέκεινα Βαβυλῶνος.
verses.ACT 7:44: Ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἦν τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καθὼς διετάξατο ὁ λαλῶν τῷ Μωϋσῇ ποιῆσαι αὐτὴν κατὰ τὸν 【τύπον】 ὃν ἑωράκει·
verses.ROM 6:17: χάρις δὲ τῷ Θεῷ ὅτι ἦτε δοῦλοι τῆς ἁμαρτίας, ὑπηκούσατε δὲ ἐκ καρδίας εἰς ὃν παρεδόθητε 【τύπον】 διδαχῆς,
verses.HEB 8:5: οἵτινες ὑποδείγματι καὶ σκιᾷ λατρεύουσιν τῶν ἐπουρανίων, καθὼς κεχρημάτισται Μωϋσῆς μέλλων ἐπιτελεῖν τὴν σκηνήν. Ὅρα γάρ φησίν, ποιήσεις πάντα κατὰ τὸν 【τύπον】 τὸν δειχθέντα σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει·
verses.ROM 5:14: ἀλλὰ ἐβασίλευσεν ὁ θάνατος ἀπὸ Ἀδὰμ μέχρι Μωϋσέως καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς μὴ ἁμαρτήσαντας ἐπὶ τῷ ὁμοιώματι τῆς παραβάσεως Ἀδάμ, ὅς ἐστιν 【τύπος】 τοῦ μέλλοντος.
verses.1CO 10:6: Ταῦτα δὲ 【τύποι】 ἡμῶν ἐγενήθησαν, εἰς τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἐπιθυμητὰς κακῶν, καθὼς κἀκεῖνοι ἐπεθύμησαν.
verses.PHP 3:17: Συνμιμηταί μου γίνεσθε, ἀδελφοί, καὶ σκοπεῖτε τοὺς οὕτως περιπατοῦντας καθὼς ἔχετε 【τύπον】 ἡμᾶς.
verses.1TH 1:7: ὥστε γενέσθαι ὑμᾶς 【τύπον】 πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ καὶ ἐν τῇ Ἀχαΐᾳ.
verses.2TH 3:9: οὐχ ὅτι οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν, ἀλλ’ ἵνα ἑαυτοὺς 【τύπον】 δῶμεν ὑμῖν εἰς τὸ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς.
verses.1TI 4:12: μηδείς σου τῆς νεότητος καταφρονείτω, ἀλλὰ 【τύπος】 γίνου τῶν πιστῶν ἐν λόγῳ, ἐν ἀναστροφῇ, ἐν ἀγάπῃ, ἐν πίστει, ἐν ἁγνείᾳ.
verses.TIT 2:7: περὶ πάντα, σεαυτὸν παρεχόμενος 【τύπον】 καλῶν ἔργων, ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ ἀφθορίαν, σεμνότητα,
verses.1PE 5:3: μηδ’ ὡς κατακυριεύοντες τῶν κλήρων ἀλλὰ 【τύποι】 γινόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου·

benchmark_ref.detail: (originally: the mark of a blow, then a stamp struck by a die), (a) a figure; a copy, image, (b) a pattern, model, (c) a type, prefiguring something or somebody.

core_meaning_summary: One single time, either as a numerical count or as a decisive, unrepeatable event, as well as in fixed phrases meaning 'more than once' or 'yet one more time'.

senses.definition: On one single occasion, as a count of frequency or within a recurring period.
senses.grammatical_frame: adverb modifying a verb or infinitive, optionally with genitive of time period (τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ)

senses.definition: On a single decisive occasion without need or possibility of repetition.
senses.grammatical_frame: adverb modifying aorist or perfect verbs/participles denoting completed or definitive action

senses.definition: In the coordinated expression καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς, indicating multiple or repeated occasions.
senses.grammatical_frame: fixed coordinated phrase καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς modifying an action verb

senses.definition: In the expression ἔτι ἅπαξ, denoting one additional and final occasion still to come.
senses.grammatical_frame: adverbial phrase ἔτι ἅπαξ modifying a future verb (or cited substantively with τό)

collocations_and_notes: Contrasted explicitly with τρίς ('three times', 2CO 11:25), πολλάκις ('many times', HEB 9:26), and ἐκ δευτέρου ('a second time', HEB 9:28). Forms two fixed expressions in this corpus: καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς ('more than once' / 'repeatedly', PHP 4:16, 1TH 2:18) and ἔτι ἅπαξ ('yet once more', HEB 12:26, HEB 12:27). In JUD 1:5 (εἰδότας ἅπαξ πάντα), it appears with a participle indicating that the recipients already/once for all know the facts being recalled.

verses.2CO 11:25: τρὶς ἐραβδίσθην, 【ἅπαξ】 ἐλιθάσθην, τρὶς ἐναυάγησα, νυχθήμερον ἐν τῷ βυθῷ πεποίηκα·
verses.HEB 9:7: εἰς δὲ τὴν δευτέραν 【ἅπαξ】 τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ μόνος ὁ ἀρχιερεύς, οὐ χωρὶς αἵματος, ὃ προσφέρει ὑπὲρ ἑαυτοῦ καὶ τῶν τοῦ λαοῦ ἀγνοημάτων,
verses.HEB 9:27: καὶ καθ’ ὅσον ἀπόκειται τοῖς ἀνθρώποις 【ἅπαξ】 ἀποθανεῖν, μετὰ δὲ τοῦτο κρίσις,
verses.HEB 9:28: οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστός, 【ἅπαξ】 προσενεχθεὶς εἰς τὸ πολλῶν ἀνενεγκεῖν ἁμαρτίας, ἐκ δευτέρου χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας ὀφθήσεται τοῖς αὐτὸν ἀπεκδεχομένοις εἰς σωτηρίαν.
verses.HEB 6:4: Ἀδύνατον γὰρ τοὺς 【ἅπαξ】 φωτισθέντας γευσαμένους τε τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς ἐπουρανίου καὶ μετόχους γενηθέντας Πνεύματος Ἁγίου
verses.HEB 9:26: ἐπεὶ ἔδει αὐτὸν πολλάκις παθεῖν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου· νυνὶ δὲ 【ἅπαξ】 ἐπὶ συντελείᾳ τῶν αἰώνων εἰς ἀθέτησιν τῆς ἁμαρτίας διὰ τῆς θυσίας αὐτοῦ πεφανέρωται.
verses.HEB 10:2: ἐπεὶ οὐκ ἂν ἐπαύσαντο προσφερόμεναι, διὰ τὸ μηδεμίαν ἔχειν ἔτι συνείδησιν ἁμαρτιῶν τοὺς λατρεύοντας 【ἅπαξ】 κεκαθαρισμένους;
verses.1PE 3:18: ὅτι καὶ Χριστὸς 【ἅπαξ】 περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ἀπέθανεν, δίκαιος ὑπὲρ ἀδίκων, ἵνα ὑμᾶς προσαγάγῃ τῷ Θεῷ, θανατωθεὶς μὲν σαρκὶ ζωοποιηθεὶς δὲ πνεύματι·
verses.JUD 1:3: Ἀγαπητοί, πᾶσαν σπουδὴν ποιούμενος γράφειν ὑμῖν περὶ τῆς κοινῆς ἡμῶν σωτηρίας, ἀνάγκην ἔσχον γράψαι ὑμῖν παρακαλῶν ἐπαγωνίζεσθαι τῇ 【ἅπαξ】 παραδοθείσῃ τοῖς ἁγίοις πίστει.
verses.JUD 1:5: Ὑπομνῆσαι δὲ ὑμᾶς βούλομαι, εἰδότας 【ἅπαξ】 πάντα, ὅτι Κύριος λαὸν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου σώσας τὸ δεύτερον τοὺς μὴ πιστεύσαντας ἀπώλεσεν,
verses.PHP 4:16: ὅτι καὶ ἐν Θεσσαλονίκῃ καὶ 【ἅπαξ】 καὶ δὶς εἰς τὴν χρείαν μοι ἐπέμψατε.
verses.1TH 2:18: διότι ἠθελήσαμεν ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἐγὼ μὲν Παῦλος καὶ 【ἅπαξ】 καὶ δίς, καὶ ἐνέκοψεν ἡμᾶς ὁ Σατανᾶς.
verses.HEB 12:26: οὗ ἡ φωνὴ τὴν γῆν ἐσάλευσεν τότε, νῦν δὲ ἐπήγγελται λέγων Ἔτι 【ἅπαξ】 ἐγὼ σείσω οὐ μόνον τὴν γῆν ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸν οὐρανόν.
verses.HEB 12:27: τὸ δὲ Ἔτι 【ἅπαξ】 δηλοῖ τὴν τῶν σαλευομένων μετάθεσιν ὡς πεποιημένων, ἵνα μείνῃ τὰ μὴ σαλευόμενα.

benchmark_ref.detail: once, once for all.

core_meaning_summary: To carry or spread through, be driven about, differ from another, surpass in value, or matter to someone.

senses.definition: To carry an object through a space, or (in the passive) to be spread and circulated throughout a region.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active + accusative + διά + genitive; or passive + διά + genitive

senses.definition: To be driven back and forth or tossed about on open water during a storm.
senses.grammatical_frame: Passive + ἐν + dative of location

senses.definition: To be distinct or different from another entity in quality or status.
senses.grammatical_frame: Intransitive active + genitive of comparison (with ἐν + dative or οὐδέν)

senses.definition: To surpass in worth or importance; as a substantivized neuter plural participle (τὰ διαφέροντα), things that are superior or truly essential.
senses.grammatical_frame: Intransitive active + genitive of comparison; or substantivized participle τὰ διαφέροντα

senses.definition: To make a difference or be of personal concern to someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Impersonal active (with οὐδέν) + dative of person

collocations_and_notes: Commonly appears with a genitive of comparison and adverbs of degree (μᾶλλον, πόσῳ, οὐδέν). In ROM 2:18 and PHP 1:10, τὰ διαφέροντα occurs as the object of δοκιμάζω ('test/approve'); while context favors 'what is superior / what matters most', the phrase could also carry the sense of discerning differences or distinctions.

core_meaning_summary: To arrive at a geographical destination, reach a person or group, or attain to a promised goal or state.

senses.definition: To reach or arrive at a city, port, or coastal point at the end of a journey or sea voyage.
senses.grammatical_frame: Intransitive + εἰς + accusative of place (or ἄντικρυς + genitive)

senses.definition: Of a message or historical era, to reach or come upon a people.
senses.grammatical_frame: Intransitive (abstract subject) + εἰς + personal accusative

senses.definition: To attain to or arrive at a promised hope, spiritual maturity, or future resurrection.
senses.grammatical_frame: Intransitive + εἰς + accusative of abstract goal or state

collocations_and_notes: Almost always construed with εἰς + accusative (once with ἄντικρυς + genitive in ACT 20:15). In Acts it is a recurring travel verb for arriving at cities and ports (often paired with sailing vocabulary like ἀποπλέω, τὸν πλοῦν διανύω, περιέρχομαι); in Paul and ACT 26:7 it describes reaching historical eras, audiences, or eschatological and spiritual goals.

benchmark_ref.detail: (a) I come down, either from high land to lower (or actually to the sea-coast), or from the high seas to the coast; hence met: I arrive at, reach (my destination), (b) of property: I come down (descend) by inheritance to an heir.

core_meaning_summary: Manner, way, or means by which something is done or happens, and by extension a person's habitual conduct or way of life.

senses.definition: The manner, method, respect, or means in which an action occurs or a comparison holds.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine noun in adverbial accusative, dative of manner, or prepositional phrase with κατά (acc.) or ἐν (dat.), often introducing comparative clauses (ὃν τρόπον, καθ’ ὃν τρόπον).

senses.definition: A person's characteristic way of life, conduct, or moral disposition, specifically in relation to money and contentment.
senses.grammatical_frame: Masculine nominative subject with predicate adjective (ἀφιλάργυρος) and accompanying participle.

collocations_and_notes: Most occurrences appear in adverbial or prepositional constructions rather than as an independent subject. Frequently forms relative clauses of comparison: accusative ὃν τρόπον ('in the way that, just as', MAT 23:37, LUK 13:34, ACT 1:11, ACT 7:28, 2TI 3:8; paired with οὕτως in ACT 1:11, 2TI 3:8) and καθ’ ὃν τρόπον (ACT 15:11, ACT 27:25). Also appears in universal or negated expressions of manner: κατὰ πάντα τρόπον ('in every way', ROM 3:2), παντὶ τρόπῳ (PHP 1:18), ἐν παντὶ τρόπῳ (2TH 3:16), κατὰ μηδένα τρόπον ('in no way', 2TH 2:3), and τὸν ὅμοιον τρόπον + dative ('in a similar way to', JUD 1:7). Sense 1b (HEB 13:5) is attested once as a nominative subject linked to financial contentment.

core_meaning_summary: To search for, strive after, or earnestly desire and request someone or something.

senses.definition: To look for or try to locate a person who is absent or missing.
senses.grammatical_frame: Transitive active verb with personal accusative direct object.

senses.definition: To strive after, pursue, or earnestly desire to obtain something (whether material provisions, a spiritual goal, or a future homeland).
senses.grammatical_frame: Transitive active verb with non-personal accusative object (or relative object in ROM 11:7).

senses.definition: To ask for, demand, or seek to hear or have a matter investigated and settled.
senses.grammatical_frame: Transitive active verb with accusative object (σημεῖον, τι περαιτέρω) or complementary infinitive (ἀκοῦσαι).

collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired with verbs of finding or attaining (contrasted with μὴ εὑρών in ACT 12:19 and οὐκ ἐπέτυχεν in ROM 11:7). In MAT 6:32 and LUK 12:30, it characterizes the pursuit of daily provisions (τὰ ἔθνη ἐπιζητοῦσιν). In MAT 12:39 and MAT 16:4, it takes σημεῖον ('a sign') as its object. In PHP 4:17, the speaker contrasts seeking a gift (τὸ δόμα) with seeking spiritual fruit (τὸν καρπόν).

core_meaning_summary: The knee of the body, especially in idioms of kneeling or bowing in prayer, homage, or submission.

senses.definition: The anatomical joint of the leg, whether as the place at which a supplicant falls or as a bodily part needing strength for endurance.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, as dative indirect object of `προσπίπτω` or accusative object of `ἀνορθόω`

senses.definition: Used with verbs of placing (`τίθημι`) or bending (`κάμπτω`) to express the act of kneeling or bowing down in prayer, worship, homage, or submission.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun in the accusative with `τίθημι` or `κάμπτω`, or nominative subject (`πᾶν γόνυ`) of `κάμπτω`

collocations_and_notes: Predominantly appears in two set expressions for kneeling: `τίθημι τὰ γόνατα` (lit. "place the knees", especially in Acts and Luke/Mark for praying or mock homage) and `κάμπτω [τὸ/τὰ] γόνυ/γόνατα` (lit. "bend the knee[s]", in Paul for worship, prayer, or allegiance). In ROM 14:11 and PHP 2:10, `πᾶν γόνυ` functions synecdochically for every person or cosmic being bowing in submission. In HEB 12:12, `τὰ παραλελυμένα γόνατα` is paired with `τὰς παρειμένας χεῖρας` as an image of physical and spiritual weariness.

core_meaning_summary: An adverb singling out a particular item, person, or subgroup for special emphasis, or marking the highest degree of a quality or feeling.

senses.definition: Singles out a specific person, subgroup, object, or circumstance from a wider context for special focus or prominence.
senses.grammatical_frame: Adverb (often with `καί` or `δέ`), introducing a noun phrase, prepositional phrase, or participial clause

senses.definition: Indicates the greatest intensity or highest degree of an emotion, action, or quality.
senses.grammatical_frame: Adverb modifying a participle or adjective

collocations_and_notes: Commonly pairs with `δέ` (`μάλιστα δέ`) or follows `καί` (`καὶ μάλιστα`) to narrow focus from a universal or broader group (e.g., `πάντας`, `πάντες οἱ ἅγιοι`, `πάντων ἀνθρώπων`, `τῶν ἰδίων`) to a specific subset or individual. In PHM 1:16, `μάλιστα ἐμοί` is explicitly contrasted with `πόσῳ δὲ μᾶλλον σοὶ`. In ACT 26:3, it introduces the specific circumstance qualifying the addressee (`μάλιστα γνώστην ὄντα σε`).

verses.ACT 25:26: περὶ οὗ ἀσφαλές τι γράψαι τῷ κυρίῳ οὐκ ἔχω· διὸ προήγαγον αὐτὸν ἐφ’ ὑμῶν καὶ 【μάλιστα】 ἐπὶ σοῦ, βασιλεῦ Ἀγρίππα, ὅπως τῆς ἀνακρίσεως γενομένης σχῶ τί γράψω·
verses.ACT 26:3: 【μάλιστα】 γνώστην ὄντα σε πάντων τῶν κατὰ Ἰουδαίους ἐθῶν τε καὶ ζητημάτων· διὸ δέομαι μακροθύμως ἀκοῦσαί μου.
verses.GAL 6:10: Ἄρα οὖν ὡς καιρὸν ἔχωμεν, ἐργαζώμεθα τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς πάντας, 【μάλιστα】 δὲ πρὸς τοὺς οἰκείους τῆς πίστεως.

verses.1TI 4:10: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ κοπιῶμεν καὶ ἀγωνιζόμεθα, ὅτι ἠλπίκαμεν ἐπὶ Θεῷ ζῶντι, ὅς ἐστιν Σωτὴρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων, 【μάλιστα】 πιστῶν.
verses.1TI 5:8: εἰ δέ τις τῶν ἰδίων καὶ 【μάλιστα】 οἰκείων οὐ προνοεῖ, τὴν πίστιν ἤρνηται καὶ ἔστιν ἀπίστου χείρων.
verses.1TI 5:17: Οἱ καλῶς προεστῶτες πρεσβύτεροι διπλῆς τιμῆς ἀξιούσθωσαν, 【μάλιστα】 οἱ κοπιῶντες ἐν λόγῳ καὶ διδασκαλίᾳ.
verses.2TI 4:13: τὸν φελόνην, ὃν ἀπέλιπον ἐν Τρῳάδι παρὰ Κάρπῳ, ἐρχόμενος φέρε, καὶ τὰ βιβλία, 【μάλιστα】 τὰς μεμβράνας.
verses.TIT 1:10: Εἰσὶν γὰρ πολλοὶ ἀνυπότακτοι, ματαιολόγοι καὶ φρεναπάται, 【μάλιστα】 οἱ ἐκ τῆς περιτομῆς,
verses.2PE 2:10: 【μάλιστα】 δὲ τοὺς ὀπίσω σαρκὸς ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ μιασμοῦ πορευομένους καὶ κυριότητος καταφρονοῦντας. τολμηταὶ, αὐθάδεις, δόξας οὐ τρέμουσιν βλασφημοῦντες,
verses.ACT 20:38: ὀδυνώμενοι 【μάλιστα】 ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ ᾧ εἰρήκει, ὅτι οὐκέτι μέλλουσιν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ θεωρεῖν. προέπεμπον δὲ αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον.

core_meaning_summary: One who works alongside others in a shared effort or contributes actively toward a person, community, or goal.

senses.definition: A colleague or partner who labors together with another person or belongs to a shared service, especially in gospel ministry.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun/substantive with personal genitive (e.g., μου, ἡμῶν, Θεοῦ)

senses.definition: One who acts in support of or contributes effort toward a specific person, benefit, or cause.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun/substantive with objective genitive, dative, or εἰς + accusative

collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired with possessive genitives (μου, ἡμῶν) in Pauline greetings and commendations, sometimes alongside ἀδελφός or συνστρατιώτης (PHP 2:25) and κοινωνός (2CO 8:23), or qualified by ἐν Χριστῷ (Ἰησοῦ) (ROM 16:3, ROM 16:9). In 1CO 3:9, Θεοῦ ... συνεργοί stands alongside Θεοῦ γεώργιον and Θεοῦ οἰκοδομή, which allows either 'co-workers belonging to God' or 'fellow workers with God'. In 2CO 1:24, cooperation toward others' joy is explicitly contrasted with exercising dominion (κυριεύομεν).

verses.PHP 4:3: ναὶ ἐρωτῶ καὶ σέ, γνήσιε σύνζυγε, συνλαμβάνου αὐταῖς, αἵτινες ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ συνήθλησάν μοι μετὰ καὶ Κλήμεντος καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν 【συνεργῶν】 μου, ὧν τὰ ὀνόματα ἐν βίβλῳ ζωῆς.

core_meaning_summary: To hold together, press in on, confine, grip with illness or emotion, or inwardly constrain and compel.

senses.definition: To close tightly or stop up a bodily opening, such as covering one's ears to shut out sound.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active transitive + accusative of body part (τὰ ὦτα)

senses.definition: To crowd around, hem in militarily, or hold a person in custody.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active transitive + personal accusative

senses.definition: To be seized, gripped, or afflicted by physical illness, pain, or intense fear.
senses.grammatical_frame: Passive + instrumental/causal dative (illness or emotion)

senses.definition: To compel or control inwardly, or (in the passive) to be distressed, wholly absorbed in a task, or torn between two possibilities.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active (abstract subject + personal accusative) or passive (absolute, + dative, or + ἐκ + genitive)

collocations_and_notes: In medical and emotional contexts, the passive pairs with instrumental datives such as νόσοις, βασάνοις, πυρετῷ/πυρετοῖς, δυσεντερίῳ, and φόβῳ. In ACT 18:5, συνείχετο τῷ λόγῳ can mean either that Paul was wholly absorbed in or compelled/pressed by the message as he testified. In military/crowd contexts, it appears alongside περικυκλόω (LUK 19:43) and ἀποθλίβω (LUK 8:45).

verses.LUK 4:38: Ἀναστὰς δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος. πενθερὰ δὲ τοῦ Σίμωνος ἦν 【συνεχομένη】 πυρετῷ μεγάλῳ, καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν περὶ αὐτῆς.

core_meaning_summary: A ground or reason for pride and boasting, or the boastful claim and confident pride itself.

senses.definition: A basis, reason, or object (including achievements or people) in which someone can take pride or boast.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun as object of ἔχω, predicate nominal, or prepositional object (εἰς)

senses.definition: An expression of pride, a boastful claim, or confident exultation about oneself, others, or a hope.
senses.grammatical_frame: Subject/object noun or genitive modifier (e.g., after ἀφορμή)

collocations_and_notes: Frequently modified by possessive pronouns/genitives (`μου`, `ὑμῶν`, `ἡμῶν`) or prepositional phrases marking the topic (`ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν/ὑμῶν`, `εἰς ἑαυτὸν`). Commonly appears as the object of `ἔχω` (`ROM 4:2`, `GAL 6:4`) and `κενόω` ("empty/nullify", `1CO 9:15`, `2CO 9:3`). In `2CO 5:12`, `ἀφορμὴν καυχήματος` is contrasted with opponents who boast (`καυχωμένους`) in outward appearance. Paired with `παρρησία` ("confidence/boldness") in `HEB 3:6`.

verses.1CO 9:16: ἐὰν γὰρ εὐαγγελίζωμαι, οὐκ ἔστιν μοι 【καύχημα·】 ἀνάγκη γάρ μοι ἐπίκειται· οὐαὶ γάρ μοί ἐστιν ἐὰν μὴ εὐαγγελίσωμαι.
verses.2CO 1:14: καθὼς καὶ ἐπέγνωτε ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ μέρους, ὅτι 【καύχημα】 ὑμῶν ἐσμεν καθάπερ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ.
verses.GAL 6:4: τὸ δὲ ἔργον ἑαυτοῦ δοκιμαζέτω ἕκαστος, καὶ τότε εἰς ἑαυτὸν μόνον τὸ 【καύχημα】 ἕξει καὶ οὐκ εἰς τὸν ἕτερον·
verses.PHP 2:16: λόγον ζωῆς ἐπέχοντες, εἰς 【καύχημα】 ἐμοὶ εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ, ὅτι οὐκ εἰς κενὸν ἔδραμον οὐδὲ εἰς κενὸν ἐκοπίασα.

verses.2CO 9:3: ἔπεμψα δὲ τοὺς ἀδελφούς, ἵνα μὴ τὸ 【καύχημα】 ἡμῶν τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν κενωθῇ ἐν τῷ μέρει τούτῳ, ἵνα καθὼς ἔλεγον παρεσκευασμένοι ἦτε,
verses.PHP 1:26: ἵνα τὸ 【καύχημα】 ὑμῶν περισσεύῃ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ διὰ τῆς ἐμῆς παρουσίας πάλιν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
verses.HEB 3:6: Χριστὸς δὲ ὡς υἱὸς ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ· οὗ οἶκός ἐσμεν ἡμεῖς, ἐὰν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ τὸ 【καύχημα】 τῆς ἐλπίδος μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν κατάσχωμεν.

core_meaning_summary: God's summons or invitation into Christian salvation and relationship, or the life-situation in which one receives that summons.

senses.definition: The divine act of summoning or inviting people to salvation, hope, and fellowship with God.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun often modified by divine genitives/adjectives, paired with καλέω, or governed by ἀξίως / ἀξιόω / μέτοχος

senses.definition: The social condition, station, or circumstances in which a person is situated when called by God.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun as object of βλέπω or governed by ἐν + cognate verb καλέω

collocations_and_notes: Frequently appears with the cognate verb `καλέω` (`1CO 7:20`, `EPH 4:1`, `EPH 4:4`, `2TI 1:9`) and with descriptors emphasizing its divine origin or goal (`τοῦ Θεοῦ`, `ἄνω`, `ἐπουρανίου`, `ἁγίᾳ`). Twice linked with `ἐλπίς` ("hope of calling", `EPH 1:18`, `EPH 4:4`), and paired with `τὰ χαρίσματα` (`ROM 11:29`) and `ἐκλογή` (`2PE 1:10`). In `1CO 1:26`, "your calling" refers to the profile and status of the believers when called, overlapping with the divine summons itself.

verses.PHP 3:14: κατὰ σκοπὸν διώκω εἰς τὸ βραβεῖον τῆς ἄνω 【κλήσεως】 τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.2TH 1:11: Εἰς ὃ καὶ προσευχόμεθα πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἵνα ὑμᾶς ἀξιώσῃ τῆς 【κλήσεως】 ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ πληρώσῃ πᾶσαν εὐδοκίαν ἀγαθωσύνης καὶ ἔργον πίστεως ἐν δυνάμει,

verses.1CO 1:26: Βλέπετε γὰρ τὴν 【κλῆσιν】 ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι οὐ πολλοὶ σοφοὶ κατὰ σάρκα, οὐ πολλοὶ δυνατοί, οὐ πολλοὶ εὐγενεῖς·
verses.1CO 7:20: ἕκαστος ἐν τῇ 【κλήσει】 ᾗ ἐκλήθη, ἐν ταύτῃ μενέτω.

senses.definition: The internal physical organs or intestines of the human body.
senses.grammatical_frame: Plural noun as subject of ἐκχέω

senses.definition: The inner center of emotion, deep affection, tenderness, and compassionate care toward others.
senses.grammatical_frame: Plural noun often with genitive of quality (ἐλέους, οἰκτιρμοῦ) or verbs of emotion/refreshment

senses.definition: A cherished person regarded as deeply dear to oneself, akin to one's own heart.
senses.grammatical_frame: Plural noun with possessive pronoun in apposition to a person

collocations_and_notes: Occurs exclusively in the plural (`τὰ σπλάγχνα`, `σπλάγχνα`, `σπλάγχνοις`) in all attested passages. Figuratively, it collocates closely with mercy and compassion vocabulary (`ἔλεος` in `LUK 1:78`, `οἰκτιρμός` in `PHP 2:1`, `COL 3:12`), with `ἀναπαύω` ("refresh", `PHM 1:7`, `PHM 1:20`), `στενοχωρέω` ("restrict", `2CO 6:12`), `ἐπιποθέω` ("long for", `PHP 1:8`), and `κλείω ἀπό` ("shut off from", `1JN 3:17`).

verses.ACT 1:18: οὗτος μὲν οὖν ἐκτήσατο χωρίον ἐκ μισθοῦ τῆς ἀδικίας, καὶ πρηνὴς γενόμενος ἐλάκησεν μέσος, καὶ ἐξεχύθη πάντα τὰ 【σπλάγχνα】 αὐτοῦ·
verses.LUK 1:78: διὰ 【σπλάγχνα】 ἐλέους Θεοῦ ἡμῶν, ἐν οἷς ἐπισκέψεται ἡμᾶς ἀνατολὴ ἐξ ὕψους,

verses.PHP 1:8: μάρτυς γάρ μου ὁ Θεός, ὡς ἐπιποθῶ πάντας ὑμᾶς ἐν 【σπλάγχνοις】 Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.PHP 2:1: Εἴ τις οὖν παράκλησις ἐν Χριστῷ, εἴ τι παραμύθιον ἀγάπης, εἴ τις κοινωνία Πνεύματος, εἴ τις 【σπλάγχνα】 καὶ οἰκτιρμοί,
verses.COL 3:12: Ἐνδύσασθε οὖν, ὡς ἐκλεκτοὶ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἅγιοι καὶ ἠγαπημένοι, 【σπλάγχνα】 οἰκτιρμοῦ, χρηστότητα, ταπεινοφροσύνην, πραΰτητα, μακροθυμίαν,
verses.PHM 1:7: χαρὰν γὰρ πολλὴν ἔσχον καὶ παράκλησιν ἐπὶ τῇ ἀγάπῃ σου, ὅτι τὰ 【σπλάγχνα】 τῶν ἁγίων ἀναπέπαυται διὰ σοῦ, ἀδελφέ.
verses.PHM 1:20: ναί, ἀδελφέ, ἐγώ σου ὀναίμην ἐν Κυρίῳ· ἀνάπαυσόν μου τὰ 【σπλάγχνα】 ἐν Χριστῷ.
verses.1JN 3:17: ὃς δ’ ἂν ἔχῃ τὸν βίον τοῦ κόσμου καὶ θεωρῇ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχοντα καὶ κλείσῃ τὰ 【σπλάγχνα】 αὐτοῦ ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ, πῶς ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ μένει ἐν αὐτῷ;
verses.PHM 1:12: ὃν ἀνέπεμψά σοι αὐτόν, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τὰ ἐμὰ 【σπλάγχνα·】

core_meaning_summary: To stand upright in a physical location, or figuratively to remain steadfast, faithful, or approved.

senses.definition: To be in an upright bodily posture or physically stationed in a place.
senses.grammatical_frame: Intransitive verb, often with a locative adverb/phrase or a circumstantial participle

senses.definition: To hold steady, remain steadfast, or persevere faithfully in a sphere, allegiance, or way of life.
senses.grammatical_frame: Intransitive verb, used absolutely (often imperative) or with `ἐν` + dative

senses.definition: To maintain one's standing or prove acceptable and approved before an authority, contrasted with failing or falling.
senses.grammatical_frame: Intransitive verb with dative of reference (`τῷ ἰδίῳ κυρίῳ`)

collocations_and_notes: Frequently appears in the imperative (`στήκετε`) with `ἐν` + dative (`ἐν τῇ πίστει`, `ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι`, `ἐν Κυρίῳ`) to urge communal or spiritual endurance. In JHN 8:44, the form `ἔστηκεν` occurs with `ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ`. In ROM 14:4, it is explicitly contrasted with `πίπτει` ("falls") and paired with `στῆσαι` from a related verb. In 2TH 2:15, it is coordinated with `κρατεῖτε` ("hold fast").

verses.MRK 3:31: Καὶ ἔρχονται ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔξω 【στήκοντες】 ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτὸν καλοῦντες αὐτόν.
