verses.JHN 1:26: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰωάνης λέγων Ἐγὼ βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι· μέσος ὑμῶν 【στήκει】 ὃν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε,
verses.JHN 8:44: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς τοῦ διαβόλου ἐστὲ καὶ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν θέλετε ποιεῖν. ἐκεῖνος ἀνθρωποκτόνος ἦν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ οὐκ 【ἔστηκεν,】 ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν αὐτῷ. ὅταν λαλῇ τὸ ψεῦδος, ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων λαλεῖ, ὅτι ψεύστης ἐστὶν καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ.
verses.1CO 16:13: Γρηγορεῖτε, 【στήκετε】 ἐν τῇ πίστει, ἀνδρίζεσθε, κραταιοῦσθε.
verses.GAL 5:1: Τῇ ἐλευθερίᾳ ἡμᾶς Χριστὸς ἠλευθέρωσεν· 【στήκετε】 οὖν καὶ μὴ πάλιν ζυγῷ δουλείας ἐνέχεσθε.
verses.PHP 1:27: Μόνον ἀξίως τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τοῦ Χριστοῦ πολιτεύεσθε, ἵνα εἴτε ἐλθὼν καὶ ἰδὼν ὑμᾶς εἴτε ἀπὼν ἀκούω τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν, ὅτι 【στήκετε】 ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι, μιᾷ ψυχῇ συναθλοῦντες τῇ πίστει τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,
verses.PHP 4:1: Ὥστε, ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοὶ καὶ ἐπιπόθητοι, χαρὰ καὶ στέφανός μου, οὕτως 【στήκετε】 ἐν Κυρίῳ, ἀγαπητοί.
verses.1TH 3:8: ὅτι νῦν ζῶμεν ἐὰν ὑμεῖς 【στήκετε】 ἐν Κυρίῳ.
verses.2TH 2:15: Ἄρα οὖν, ἀδελφοί, 【στήκετε,】 καὶ κρατεῖτε τὰς παραδόσεις ἃς ἐδιδάχθητε εἴτε διὰ λόγου εἴτε δι’ ἐπιστολῆς ἡμῶν.
verses.ROM 14:4: σὺ τίς εἶ ὁ κρίνων ἀλλότριον οἰκέτην; τῷ ἰδίῳ κυρίῳ 【στήκει】 ἢ πίπτει· σταθήσεται δέ, δυνατεῖ γὰρ ὁ Κύριος στῆσαι αὐτόν.

core_meaning_summary: Favorable recognition, commendation, or praise bestowed on someone for good conduct, or honor directed toward God.

senses.definition: Commendation, approval, or favorable recognition granted to people by God, governing authorities, or fellow believers for faithfulness or good deeds.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, as subject or object, or in `εἰς ἔπαινον`, frequently with `ἐκ`/`ἀπό` + genitive of source or an objective genitive

senses.definition: Acclaim, honor, and adoration directed toward God or his glorious grace.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun in the prepositional phrase `εἰς ἔπαινον` + genitive of the one praised

senses.definition: A quality or deed that deserves commendation or favorable mention.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun in a conditional clause (`εἴ τις ἔπαινος`), paired with `ἀρετή`

collocations_and_notes: Often occurs in prepositional phrases with `εἰς` (`εἰς ἔπαινον`, especially `εἰς ἔπαινον [τῆς] δόξης αὐτοῦ` in Ephesians) and is coordinated with `δόξα` ("glory") and `τιμή` ("honor"). When designating approval received by humans, the source is marked by `ἐκ` or `ἀπό` + genitive (`ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ`, `ἐξ αὐτῆς`, `ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ`). In 1PE 2:14, `ἔπαινον ἀγαθοποιῶν` contrasts directly with `ἐκδίκησιν κακοποιῶν`.

verses.ROM 2:29: ἀλλ’ ὁ ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ Ἰουδαῖος, καὶ περιτομὴ καρδίας ἐν πνεύματι οὐ γράμματι, οὗ ὁ 【ἔπαινος】 οὐκ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἀλλ’ ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ.
verses.ROM 13:3: οἱ γὰρ ἄρχοντες οὐκ εἰσὶν φόβος τῷ ἀγαθῷ ἔργῳ ἀλλὰ τῷ κακῷ. θέλεις δὲ μὴ φοβεῖσθαι τὴν ἐξουσίαν; τὸ ἀγαθὸν ποίει, καὶ ἕξεις 【ἔπαινον】 ἐξ αὐτῆς·
verses.1CO 4:5: ὥστε μὴ πρὸ καιροῦ τι κρίνετε, ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ ὁ Κύριος, ὃς καὶ φωτίσει τὰ κρυπτὰ τοῦ σκότους καὶ φανερώσει τὰς βουλὰς τῶν καρδιῶν· καὶ τότε ὁ 【ἔπαινος】 γενήσεται ἑκάστῳ ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ.
verses.2CO 8:18: συνεπέμψαμεν δὲ μετ’ αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀδελφὸν οὗ ὁ 【ἔπαινος】 ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ διὰ πασῶν τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν,
verses.1PE 1:7: ἵνα τὸ δοκίμιον ὑμῶν τῆς πίστεως πολυτιμότερον χρυσίου τοῦ ἀπολλυμένου, διὰ πυρὸς δὲ δοκιμαζομένου, εὑρεθῇ εἰς 【ἔπαινον】 καὶ δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·
verses.1PE 2:14: εἴτε ἡγεμόσιν ὡς δι’ αὐτοῦ πεμπομένοις εἰς ἐκδίκησιν κακοποιῶν 【ἔπαινον】 δὲ ἀγαθοποιῶν·
verses.EPH 1:6: εἰς 【ἔπαινον】 δόξης τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ Ἠγαπημένῳ,
verses.EPH 1:12: εἰς τὸ εἶναι ἡμᾶς εἰς 【ἔπαινον】 δόξης αὐτοῦ τοὺς προηλπικότας ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ·
verses.EPH 1:14: ὅς ἐστιν ἀρραβὼν τῆς κληρονομίας ἡμῶν, εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῆς περιποιήσεως, εἰς 【ἔπαινον】 τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.

verses.PHP 4:8: Τὸ λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί, ὅσα ἐστὶν ἀληθῆ, ὅσα σεμνά, ὅσα δίκαια, ὅσα ἁγνά, ὅσα προσφιλῆ, ὅσα εὔφημα, εἴ τις ἀρετὴ καὶ εἴ τις 【ἔπαινος,】 ταῦτα λογίζεσθε·

core_meaning_summary: A written document, book, or scroll—whether a literary record, a collection of sacred writings, or a figurative register of names.

senses.definition: A physical written work, scroll, or volume, including an introductory genealogical record, a collection of authoritative or prophetic writings, or a book of esoteric practices.
senses.grammatical_frame: feminine noun, singular or plural, used in headings, as direct object, or after ἐν + dative with a genitive modifier

senses.definition: A figurative or heavenly register in which individuals' names are recorded as belonging to life.
senses.grammatical_frame: feminine singular noun in the phrase (τῇ) βίβλῳ (τῆς) ζωῆς, governed by ἐν + dative or ἐκ + genitive

collocations_and_notes: Frequently appears in the prepositional phrase ἐν (τῇ) βίβλῳ with a genitive modifier indicating author, content, or category (e.g., Μωϋσέως, λόγων Ἡσαΐου, ψαλμῶν, τῶν προφητῶν), often introduced by γέγραπται ('it is written') to cite authoritative writings. In PHP 4:3, REV 3:5, and REV 20:15, occurs in the fixed expression βίβλος (τῆς) ζωῆς ('book of life'), where names are written in or erased from it. In ACT 19:19, the plural τὰς βίβλους refers to physical volumes/scrolls with monetary value that can be burned.

verses.MAT 1:1: 【Βίβλος】 γενέσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ υἱοῦ Δαυεὶδ υἱοῦ Ἀβραάμ.

verses.LUK 20:42: αὐτὸς γὰρ Δαυεὶδ λέγει ἐν 【βίβλῳ】 ψαλμῶν Εἶπεν Κύριος τῷ Κυρίῳ μου Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου
verses.ACT 1:20: γέγραπται γὰρ ἐν 【βίβλῳ】 Ψαλμῶν Γενηθήτω ἡ ἔπαυλις αὐτοῦ ἔρημος καὶ μὴ ἔστω ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν αὐτῇ, καί Τὴν ἐπισκοπὴν αὐτοῦ λαβέτω ἕτερος.
verses.ACT 7:42: ἔστρεψεν δὲ ὁ Θεὸς καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς λατρεύειν τῇ στρατιᾷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν 【βίβλῳ】 τῶν προφητῶν Μὴ σφάγια καὶ θυσίας προσηνέγκατέ μοι ἔτη τεσσεράκοντα ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, οἶκος Ἰσραήλ,
verses.ACT 19:19: ἱκανοὶ δὲ τῶν τὰ περίεργα πραξάντων συνενέγκαντες τὰς 【βίβλους】 κατέκαιον ἐνώπιον πάντων· καὶ συνεψήφισαν τὰς τιμὰς αὐτῶν καὶ εὗρον ἀργυρίου μυριάδας πέντε.
verses.PHP 4:3: ναὶ ἐρωτῶ καὶ σέ, γνήσιε σύνζυγε, συνλαμβάνου αὐταῖς, αἵτινες ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ συνήθλησάν μοι μετὰ καὶ Κλήμεντος καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν συνεργῶν μου, ὧν τὰ ὀνόματα ἐν 【βίβλῳ】 ζωῆς.
verses.REV 3:5: Ὁ νικῶν οὕτως περιβαλεῖται ἐν ἱματίοις λευκοῖς, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξαλείψω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς 【βίβλου】 τῆς ζωῆς, καὶ ὁμολογήσω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Πατρός μου καὶ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ.
verses.REV 20:15: καὶ εἴ τις οὐχ εὑρέθη ἐν τῇ 【βίβλῳ】 τῆς ζωῆς γεγραμμένος, ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρός.

core_meaning_summary: Quickly, without delay, within a short time, or with undue haste.

senses.definition: With physical speed or promptness of action, without delay.
senses.grammatical_frame: adverb modifying an imperative or aorist indicative verb of action

senses.definition: Within a short interval of time from the present; in the near future.
senses.grammatical_frame: adverb modifying a future indicative verb or an infinitive of anticipated arrival or sending

senses.definition: Readily, rashly, or prematurely, without sufficient caution or stability.
senses.grammatical_frame: adverb modifying present/aorist verbs or imperatives, often with οὕτως or a negation (μή, μηδείς)

collocations_and_notes: In GAL 1:6, οὕτως ταχέως ('so quickly / so soon') can carry both temporal force (short time elapsed) and qualitative force (readily/rashly). In 2TH 2:2 and 1TI 5:22, negated contexts (μὴ ταχέως, μηδενὶ ταχέως) warn against acting or reacting prematurely or without careful discernment. Collocates frequently with verbs of motion or sending (ἐξέρχομαι, ἔρχομαι, πέμπω).

verses.LUK 14:21: καὶ παραγενόμενος ὁ δοῦλος ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα. τότε ὀργισθεὶς ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης εἶπεν τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ Ἔξελθε 【ταχέως】 εἰς τὰς πλατείας καὶ ῥύμας τῆς πόλεως, καὶ τοὺς πτωχοὺς καὶ ἀναπήρους καὶ τυφλοὺς καὶ χωλοὺς εἰσάγαγε ὧδε.
verses.LUK 16:6: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ἑκατὸν βάτους ἐλαίου. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Δέξαι σου τὰ γράμματα καὶ καθίσας 【ταχέως】 γράψον πεντήκοντα.
verses.JHN 11:31: οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι οἱ ὄντες μετ’ αὐτῆς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ καὶ παραμυθούμενοι αὐτήν, ἰδόντες τὴν Μαριὰμ ὅτι 【ταχέως】 ἀνέστη καὶ ἐξῆλθεν, ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῇ, δόξαντες ὅτι ὑπάγει εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον ἵνα κλαύσῃ ἐκεῖ.
verses.1CO 4:19: ἐλεύσομαι δὲ 【ταχέως】 πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἐὰν ὁ Κύριος θελήσῃ, καὶ γνώσομαι οὐ τὸν λόγον τῶν πεφυσιωμένων ἀλλὰ τὴν δύναμιν·
verses.PHP 2:19: Ἐλπίζω δὲ ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Τιμόθεον 【ταχέως】 πέμψαι ὑμῖν, ἵνα κἀγὼ εὐψυχῶ γνοὺς τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν.
verses.PHP 2:24: πέποιθα δὲ ἐν Κυρίῳ ὅτι καὶ αὐτὸς 【ταχέως】 ἐλεύσομαι.
verses.GAL 1:6: Θαυμάζω ὅτι οὕτως 【ταχέως】 μετατίθεσθε ἀπὸ τοῦ καλέσαντος ὑμᾶς ἐν χάριτι Χριστοῦ εἰς ἕτερον εὐαγγέλιον,
verses.2TH 2:2: εἰς τὸ μὴ 【ταχέως】 σαλευθῆναι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ νοὸς μηδὲ θροεῖσθαι μήτε διὰ πνεύματος μήτε διὰ λόγου μήτε δι’ ἐπιστολῆς ὡς δι’ ἡμῶν, ὡς ὅτι ἐνέστηκεν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ Κυρίου.
verses.1TI 5:22: Χεῖρας 【ταχέως】 μηδενὶ ἐπιτίθει, μηδὲ κοινώνει ἁμαρτίαις ἀλλοτρίαις· σεαυτὸν ἁγνὸν τήρει.

benchmark_ref.detail: soon, quickly, hastily.

core_meaning_summary: To openly acknowledge or confess (sins, deeds, or a truth), to give thankful praise to God, or (in the active voice) to agree/consent.

senses.definition: To admit or disclose one's sins or past practices openly.
senses.grammatical_frame: middle voice, typically with an accusative direct object (τὰς ἁμαρτίας) and optionally a dative recipient (ἀλλήλοις), or paired with ἀναγγέλλω

senses.definition: To declare or acknowledge openly a truth or status.
senses.grammatical_frame: middle voice followed by a ὅτι clause stating the content of the declaration

senses.definition: To offer thankful praise or reverent acknowledgment to God.
senses.grammatical_frame: middle voice with a dative recipient referring to God (σοι, τῷ Θεῷ), sometimes followed by a ὅτι clause giving the reason

senses.definition: To agree or consent to a proposed arrangement.
senses.grammatical_frame: active voice, used intransitively without an expressed object

collocations_and_notes: Nine of the ten occurrences are in the middle voice, spanning admission of sins/deeds (MAT 3:6, MRK 1:5, ACT 19:18, JAS 5:16), open declaration of a core belief (PHP 2:11), and thankful praise or acknowledgment directed to God (MAT 11:25, LUK 10:21, ROM 14:11, ROM 15:9). The single active occurrence (LUK 22:6) lacks a direct object and denotes agreeing or consenting to a proposal. Notice the parallel verbs δοξάσαι and ψαλῶ in ROM 15:9, κάμψει πᾶν γόνυ in ROM 14:11, and ἀναγγέλλοντες in ACT 19:18.

verses.MAT 3:6: καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ 【ἐξομολογούμενοι】 τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.
verses.MRK 1:5: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία χώρα καὶ οἱ Ἱεροσολυμεῖται πάντες, καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ 【ἐξομολογούμενοι】 τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.
verses.ACT 19:18: πολλοί τε τῶν πεπιστευκότων ἤρχοντο 【ἐξομολογούμενοι】 καὶ ἀναγγέλλοντες τὰς πράξεις αὐτῶν.

core_meaning_summary: A subordinating conjunction introducing a known reason or premise ('since, because'), or occasionally a completed prior event ('when, after').

senses.definition: Introduces an established fact, situation, or premise serving as the reason or ground for a following or preceding statement, question, or course of action.
senses.grammatical_frame: subordinating conjunction introducing a causal clause with an indicative verb, sometimes paired with γάρ or καί

senses.definition: Introduces a prior event that has been completed before the action of the main clause takes place.
senses.grammatical_frame: subordinating conjunction introducing a temporal clause with an aorist indicative verb

collocations_and_notes: Predominantly causal (9 of 10 occurrences), introducing a premise or established circumstance that motivates a statement, question, or action; often combined with γάρ (1CO 1:21, 15:21) or καί (1CO 1:22). In ACT 15:24, it opens a formal statement introducing the background reason. Only in LUK 7:1 does it function purely temporally with an aorist verb to mark the completion of a prior event before the next narrative action.

core_meaning_summary: To carry out an undertaking, ritual duty, or process to its full completion, or (in the middle/passive) to reach completion or be experienced.

senses.definition: To bring an action, task, gracious project, or moral quality to full completion or realization.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active verb + accusative object or substantival infinitive

senses.definition: To construct a sacred structure or regularly perform prescribed acts of worship and priestly service.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active verb + accusative of sacred structure or ritual service

senses.definition: To reach completion or perfection by some means, or (of sufferings) to be imposed on and undergone by a group.
senses.grammatical_frame: Middle or passive verb + dative of means or affected group

collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired with verbs of beginning (`ἐνάρχομαι`, `προενάρχομαι`) to contrast starting an endeavor with bringing it to full completion (`2CO 8:6`, `GAL 3:3`, `PHP 1:6`). In `2CO 8:11`, it contrasts with willing/desiring (`θέλειν`) and takes a substantival infinitive (`τὸ ποιῆσαι`) as its object. In `GAL 3:3`, the middle/passive form `ἐπιτελεῖσθε` allows either a middle reading ("finish for yourselves") or passive reading ("be brought to completion"); in `1PE 5:9`, the passive infinitive with `τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν παθημάτων` expresses hardships being carried out upon or experienced by the Christian community.

core_meaning_summary: Upward in direction or highest spatial limit, and by extension located above in the heavenly realm.

senses.definition: Indicates position in the upper or heavenly sphere, or origin from that sphere, either reinforcing a locative phrase or standing in attributive position with a noun.
senses.grammatical_frame: adverb in apposition to a locative prepositional phrase, or in attributive position between article and noun

senses.definition: Denotes the heavenly domain or the realities belonging to God's sphere where Christ is seated, contrasted with earthly existence.

senses.definition: To yearn or desire intensely in a jealous or envious manner (used in a syntactically disputed clause concerning the spirit dwelling within).

core_meaning_summary: The official residence or headquarters of a governor or ruler, or the personnel/guard body associated with such an official seat.

senses.definition: The official residence, palace, or military headquarters of a Roman governor or client ruler, having an inner courtyard and facilities for troops or custody.
senses.grammatical_frame: Neuter noun with definite article, frequently following spatial prepositions (eis, en) or qualified by a possessive genitive

senses.definition: An official imperial guard corps or headquarters personnel among whom a prisoner's situation becomes known.
senses.grammatical_frame: Neuter noun with definite article and adjective holos after preposition en, coordinated with plural personal dative

collocations_and_notes: In the Gospels (MAT 27:27, MRK 15:16, JHN 18:28, JHN 18:33, JHN 19:9), it is the Roman governor's headquarters/residence containing an interior courtyard (aulē) where an entire cohort (speira) can assemble and which Judean leaders avoid entering to preserve ritual purity. In ACT 23:35 it is specified as 'of Herod' (tou Hērōdou) and serves as a place of detention. In PHP 1:13 it is coordinated with 'all the rest' (tois loipois pasin), referring to persons or a military/official body.
uncertainty_note: In PHP 1:13, the coordination of en holō tō praitōriō with tois loipois pasin ('and to all the rest') strongly points to a group of people (such as an imperial guard or military corps), but the single sentence does not definitively rule out a spatial reference to a palace or military headquarters complex as the setting where those people are found.

collocations_and_notes: In positive ethical contexts, frequently appears after μετὰ πάσης ("with all," ACT 20:19, EPH 4:2) and alongside πραΰτης ("gentleness") and μακροθυμία ("patience"). In Colossians 2, it is grouped with θρησκεία τῶν ἀγγέλων ("worship of angels"), ἐθελοθρησκία ("self-imposed religion"), and ἀφειδία σώματος ("harsh treatment of the body") in polemical critique.

core_meaning_summary: To arrive upon, reach a goal or location, or come temporally ahead of someone else.

senses.definition: To arrive upon or come onto people with decisive effect, used of the kingdom of God or divine wrath.
senses.grammatical_frame: intransitive verb + ἐπί + accusative of person

senses.definition: To reach or attain a geographic destination, standard, or stage of progress.
senses.grammatical_frame: intransitive verb + εἰς + accusative or ἄχρι + genitive

senses.definition: To arrive before or gain temporal precedence over someone else.
senses.grammatical_frame: transitive verb + accusative of person

collocations_and_notes: When followed by ἐπί + accusative (MAT 12:28, LUK 11:20, 1TH 2:16), the subject is an authoritative divine reality (the kingdom of God or wrath) coming upon people. In 1TH 4:15 it takes a direct accusative object of persons in an emphatic negated subjunctive (οὐ μὴ φθάσωμεν) to express temporal priority.

core_meaning_summary: To be physically away or absent from a person or group.

senses.definition: To be physically distant or not present in person with others, often contrasted with physical arrival or spiritual closeness.
senses.grammatical_frame: intransitive verb (finite indicative or adverbial present participle), optionally with a dative of respect (e.g., τῷ σώματι, τῇ σαρκί)

collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired in direct contrast with words for presence, especially πάρειμι ("be present": 1CO 5:3, 2CO 10:11, 13:2, 13:10), ἔρχομαι ("come": 2CO 13:2, PHP 1:27), or σὺν ὑμῖν εἰμι ("be with you": COL 2:5). In 1CO 5:3 (τῷ σώματι) and COL 2:5 (τῇ σαρκί), a dative noun specifies bodily/physical absence in contrast to being present in spirit (τῷ πνεύματι). In 2CO 10:11 and 13:10, being absent is associated with communicating by letter (δι’ ἐπιστολῶν, γράφω).

core_meaning_summary: To impart strength or capability to someone, or (in passive/middle) to be strengthened and grow strong.

senses.definition: To supply someone with strength, ability, or inner power to endure or carry out an assigned task.
senses.grammatical_frame: active transitive verb + accusative direct object

senses.definition: To receive strength, become fortified, or grow stronger in resolve, faith, or spiritual capacity.
senses.grammatical_frame: passive or middle intransitive verb, often with an instrumental dative or ἐν + dative specifying the sphere or source

collocations_and_notes: In the active voice, the subject is consistently Christ/the Lord and the object is the first-person pronoun με (PHP 4:13, 1TI 1:12, 2TI 4:17), empowering the recipient for endurance, ministry (εἰς διακονίαν), or proclamation (τὸ κήρυγμα). In the passive/middle, the source or sphere of strength is marked by the dative τῇ πίστει (ROM 4:20) or by ἐν + dative: ἐν Κυρίῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ κράτει τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ (EPH 6:10) and ἐν τῇ χάριτι (2TI 2:1).

core_meaning_summary: Belonging to, situated on, or characteristic of the earthly realm as contrasted with what is heavenly.

senses.definition: Belonging to, constituted for, or originating within the mortal earthly sphere rather than the heavenly realm.
senses.grammatical_frame: two-termination adjective (attributive, elliptical, or predicate)

senses.definition: Matters, realities, or concerns belonging to the present earthly world, as opposed to heavenly truths or spiritual realities.
senses.grammatical_frame: substantival neuter plural with definite article (τὰ ἐπίγεια)

senses.definition: Beings inhabiting the earth, listed in a threefold cosmic division between heavenly beings and those under the earth.

core_meaning_summary: A self-interested, rivalrous disposition or factious behavior that opposes humility and produces communal strife.

senses.definition: An inner motive or attitude of self-promoting rivalry, contentiousness, or factious ambition, opposed to humility, sincerity, and truth.
senses.grammatical_frame: singular abstract noun (as direct object, subject, or in prepositional phrases with ἐκ or κατά)

senses.definition: Outward acts or manifestations of rivalrous strife and factional division within a community.
senses.grammatical_frame: plural noun in lists of communal vices

collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired with ζῆλος ("jealousy/zeal": 2CO 12:20, GAL 5:20, JAS 3:14, 3:16), ἔρις ("strife": 2CO 12:20, GAL 5:20), θυμοί ("outbursts of anger": 2CO 12:20, GAL 5:20), and ἀκαταστασία/ἀκαταστασίαι ("disorder": 2CO 12:20, JAS 3:16). Contrasted directly with ταπεινοφροσύνη ("humility": PHP 2:3), sincere purity (ἁγνῶς: PHP 1:17), and obedience to the truth (ROM 2:8, JAS 3:14). Prepositional phrases ἐξ ἐριθείας (ROM 2:8, PHP 1:17) and κατ’ ἐριθείαν (PHP 2:3) denote acting out of or according to this motive.
uncertainty_note: From these seven contexts alone, the word overlaps with both internal self-seeking ambition (contrasted with humility and paired with vain conceit in PHP 2:3) and outward contentious factionalism (listed with strife, jealousy, dissensions, and disorder in 2CO 12:20, GAL 5:20, JAS 3:16), making it uncertain whether the primary focus is self-advancement or partisan rivalry.

core_meaning_summary: Public disgrace, humiliation, or shameful conduct that brings reproach.

senses.grammatical_frame: Noun (feminine), in prepositional phrase μετὰ + genitive, as genitive object of καταφρονέω, or as subject modified by a genitive

senses.definition: Disgraceful behavior, hidden wrongdoing, or shameful deeds that merit reproach.

core_meaning_summary: Two times or on two occasions, indicating repeated action or recurring frequency.

senses.definition: On two separate occasions, a second time, or twice within a specified recurring period (when paired with a genitive of time).
senses.grammatical_frame: Adverb modifying a verb or participle; with genitive of time (τοῦ σαββάτου) to express frequency per period

senses.definition: In the idiomatic pairing καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς: more than once, repeatedly, on multiple occasions.
senses.grammatical_frame: Adverb in the fixed coordinate phrase καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς modifying a main verb

core_meaning_summary: To suffer loss, be deprived of, or forfeit something of value (attested in the passive voice).

collocations_and_notes: All six occurrences in the packet are in the passive voice. Frequently contrasted directly with κερδαίνω ("to gain", MAT 16:26; MRK 8:36; LUK 9:25; PHP 3:8) and paired with the cognate noun ζημία ("loss") in PHP 3:8. Parallel to ἀπόλλυμι ("to destroy/lose") in LUK 9:25.

verses.MAT 16:26: τί γὰρ ὠφεληθήσεται ἄνθρωπος ἐὰν τὸν κόσμον ὅλον κερδήσῃ, τὴν δὲ ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ 【ζημιωθῇ;】 ἢ τί δώσει ἄνθρωπος ἀντάλλαγμα τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ;
verses.MRK 8:36: τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖ ἄνθρωπον κερδῆσαι τὸν κόσμον ὅλον καὶ 【ζημιωθῆναι】 τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ;
verses.LUK 9:25: τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖται ἄνθρωπος κερδήσας τὸν κόσμον ὅλον ἑαυτὸν δὲ ἀπολέσας ἢ 【ζημιωθείς;】
verses.PHP 3:8: ἀλλὰ μὲν οὖν γε καὶ ἡγοῦμαι πάντα ζημίαν εἶναι διὰ τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου μου, δι’ ὃν τὰ πάντα 【ἐζημιώθην,】 καὶ ἡγοῦμαι σκύβαλα ἵνα Χριστὸν κερδήσω
verses.1CO 3:15: εἴ τινος τὸ ἔργον κατακαήσεται, 【ζημιωθήσεται,】 αὐτὸς δὲ σωθήσεται, οὕτως δὲ ὡς διὰ πυρός.
verses.2CO 7:9: νῦν χαίρω, οὐχ ὅτι ἐλυπήθητε, ἀλλ’ ὅτι ἐλυπήθητε εἰς μετάνοιαν· ἐλυπήθητε γὰρ κατὰ Θεόν, ἵνα ἐν μηδενὶ 【ζημιωθῆτε】 ἐξ ἡμῶν.

benchmark_ref.detail: I inflict loss (damage) upon, fine, punish, sometimes with the acc. of the penalty, even when the verb is passive.

core_meaning_summary: Official sacred or priestly service, or practical ministry and relief rendered on behalf of others.

senses.definition: Sacred, priestly, or cultic service and ministry performed in relation to God or a sanctuary (including figurative sacrificial service of faith).
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun (feminine), frequently in genitive constructions (e.g., τὰ σκεύη τῆς λειτουργίας, αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς λειτουργίας) or paired with θυσία

senses.definition: Practical ministry, aid, or material contribution rendered to supply the needs of others.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun (feminine), as genitive dependent on διακονία or ὑστέρημα, sometimes with πρός + accusative for recipient

collocations_and_notes: Associated with temple/tabernacle duties and equipment (LUK 1:23; HEB 9:21) and Christ's covenantal ministry (HEB 8:6). In PHP 2:17, paired with θυσία ("sacrifice") and σπένδομαι ("be poured out as a drink offering"). In 2CO 9:12 and PHP 2:30, connected with filling up needs/lacks (ὑστέρημα) via ἀναπληρόω / προσαναπληρόω.

verses.LUK 1:23: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς 【λειτουργίας】 αὐτοῦ, ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.
verses.PHP 2:17: Ἀλλὰ εἰ καὶ σπένδομαι ἐπὶ τῇ θυσίᾳ καὶ 【λειτουργίᾳ】 τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν, χαίρω καὶ συνχαίρω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν·
verses.HEB 8:6: νῦν δὲ διαφορωτέρας τέτυχεν 【λειτουργίας,】 ὅσῳ καὶ κρείττονός ἐστιν διαθήκης μεσίτης, ἥτις ἐπὶ κρείττοσιν ἐπαγγελίαις νενομοθέτηται.
verses.HEB 9:21: καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν δὲ καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τῆς 【λειτουργίας】 τῷ αἵματι ὁμοίως ἐράντισεν.
verses.2CO 9:12: ὅτι ἡ διακονία τῆς 【λειτουργίας】 ταύτης οὐ μόνον ἐστὶν προσαναπληροῦσα τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν ἁγίων, ἀλλὰ καὶ περισσεύουσα διὰ πολλῶν εὐχαριστιῶν τῷ Θεῷ·
verses.PHP 2:30: ὅτι διὰ τὸ ἔργον Χριστοῦ μέχρι θανάτου ἤγγισεν παραβολευσάμενος τῇ ψυχῇ, ἵνα ἀναπληρώσῃ τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα τῆς πρός με 【λειτουργίας.】

benchmark_ref.detail: a charitable gift, public service in the widest sense; service as of priest or Levite ritual.

core_meaning_summary: The human mind or faculty of understanding, an individual thought or conception, or a calculated scheme of an adversary.

senses.definition: The mind or faculty of perception and thought, viewed as something capable of being dulled, blinded, led astray, or guarded.
senses.grammatical_frame: Plural noun with genitive of person, as subject of passive verbs or direct object of transitive verbs

senses.definition: An individual thought, mental conception, or reasoning that can be brought into submission.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun modified by πᾶν ('every'), as direct object of αἰχμαλωτίζοντες ('taking captive')

senses.definition: A plan, intention, or scheme devised to take advantage of others.
senses.grammatical_frame: Plural noun with genitive of an adversary (αὐτοῦ, referring to Satan), as direct object of ἀγνοοῦμεν ('be ignorant of')

collocations_and_notes: Frequently used in the plural with a genitive of the person whose mental life is affected (e.g., τὰ νοήματα αὐτῶν / τῶν ἀπίστων / ὑμῶν). Paired with καρδία ('heart') as an object guarded by God's peace in PHP 4:7 (cf. also νοῦς in the same verse). In 2CO 11:3 and PHP 4:7, the plural may encompass both the mind as a faculty and its thoughts. In 2CO 2:11, the plural with Satan as genitive denotes hostile designs rather than a cognitive faculty.

verses.2CO 3:14: ἀλλὰ ἐπωρώθη τὰ 【νοήματα】 αὐτῶν. ἄχρι γὰρ τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας τὸ αὐτὸ κάλυμμα ἐπὶ τῇ ἀναγνώσει τῆς παλαιᾶς διαθήκης μένει, μὴ ἀνακαλυπτόμενον, ὅτι ἐν Χριστῷ καταργεῖται·
verses.2CO 4:4: ἐν οἷς ὁ θεὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου ἐτύφλωσεν τὰ 【νοήματα】 τῶν ἀπίστων εἰς τὸ μὴ αὐγάσαι τὸν φωτισμὸν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς δόξης τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅς ἐστιν εἰκὼν τοῦ Θεοῦ.
verses.2CO 11:3: φοβοῦμαι δὲ μή πως, ὡς ὁ ὄφις ἐξηπάτησεν Εὕαν ἐν τῇ πανουργίᾳ αὐτοῦ, φθαρῇ τὰ 【νοήματα】 ὑμῶν ἀπὸ τῆς ἁπλότητος καὶ τῆς ἁγνότητος τῆς εἰς Χριστόν.
verses.PHP 4:7: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡ ὑπερέχουσα πάντα νοῦν φρουρήσει τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ 【νοήματα】 ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.2CO 10:5: καὶ πᾶν ὕψωμα ἐπαιρόμενον κατὰ τῆς γνώσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ αἰχμαλωτίζοντες πᾶν 【νόημα】 εἰς τὴν ὑπακοὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.2CO 2:11: ἵνα μὴ πλεονεκτηθῶμεν ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ· οὐ γὰρ αὐτοῦ τὰ 【νοήματα】 ἀγνοοῦμεν.

benchmark_ref.detail: a thought, purpose, design; the mind; the heart, soul, feelings.

core_meaning_summary: A state of confident assurance, trust, or reliance placed in God, other people, one's course of action, or external credentials.

senses.definition: Confident assurance or trust, whether directed toward God or others, characterizing approach to God, or emboldening action and confrontation.
senses.grammatical_frame: Noun as direct object of ἔχω, in ἐν + dative, or in bare dative of manner/cause; sometimes with πρός + acc, εἰς + acc, or διά + gen

senses.definition: Reliance or a basis for confidence placed in human or fleshly status.
senses.grammatical_frame: Singular noun as direct object of ἔχων followed by ἐν + dative (ἐν σαρκί)

collocations_and_notes: Occurs with ἔχω ('have') in 2CO 3:4 and PHP 3:4, and in the dative of manner, means, or accompaniment in 2CO 1:15, 2CO 8:22, and 2CO 10:2. Paired with παρρησία ('boldness') and προσαγωγή ('access') in EPH 3:12, and with θαρρέω ('be bold') and τολμάω ('dare') in 2CO 10:2. In 2CO 1:15, the referent of ταύτῃ τῇ πεποιθήσει depends on preceding discourse not included in the verse itself. In PHP 3:4, the noun parallels the cognate infinitive πεποιθέναι ἐν σαρκί in the immediately following clause.

verses.2CO 1:15: Καὶ ταύτῃ τῇ 【πεποιθήσει】 ἐβουλόμην πρότερον πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλθεῖν ἵνα δευτέραν χάριν σχῆτε,
verses.2CO 3:4: 【Πεποίθησιν】 δὲ τοιαύτην ἔχομεν διὰ τοῦ Χριστοῦ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν.
verses.2CO 8:22: συνεπέμψαμεν δὲ αὐτοῖς τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν, ὃν ἐδοκιμάσαμεν ἐν πολλοῖς πολλάκις σπουδαῖον ὄντα, νυνὶ δὲ πολὺ σπουδαιότερον 【πεποιθήσει】 πολλῇ τῇ εἰς ὑμᾶς.
verses.2CO 10:2: δέομαι δὲ τὸ μὴ παρὼν θαρρῆσαι τῇ 【πεποιθήσει】 ᾗ λογίζομαι τολμῆσαι ἐπί τινας τοὺς λογιζομένους ἡμᾶς ὡς κατὰ σάρκα περιπατοῦντας.
verses.EPH 3:12: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ προσαγωγὴν ἐν 【πεποιθήσει】 διὰ τῆς πίστεως αὐτοῦ.
verses.PHP 3:4: καίπερ ἐγὼ ἔχων 【πεποίθησιν】 καὶ ἐν σαρκί. Εἴ τις δοκεῖ ἄλλος πεποιθέναι ἐν σαρκί, ἐγὼ μᾶλλον·

benchmark_ref.detail: confidence, trust, reliance.

core_meaning_summary: An outward pretense or pretext concealing an ulterior motive, or a valid excuse offered for wrongdoing.

senses.definition: A false show, pretext, or insincere pretense put forward to disguise an ulterior motive or self-interest.
senses.grammatical_frame: Bare dative of manner (προφάσει) or prepositional phrase (ἐν προφάσει), sometimes followed by ὡς + participle or a genitive specifying the concealed vice

senses.definition: A valid excuse, plea, or justification that would absolve someone from guilt or blame.
senses.grammatical_frame: Accusative singular as direct object of ἔχω ('have'), with περί + genitive ('concerning')

collocations_and_notes: In 5 of 6 occurrences, appears in the dative (either bare dative προφάσει or ἐν προφάσει) to express false show or ulterior motive. Explicitly contrasted with ἀληθείᾳ ('in truth/sincerely') in PHP 1:18. MRK 12:40 and LUK 20:47 preserve nearly identical phrasing contrasting pious display with exploiting widows. In 1TH 2:5, the genitive πλεονεξίας ('of greed') identifies the hidden vice masked by the pretext.

verses.MRK 12:40: οἱ κατεσθίοντες τὰς οἰκίας τῶν χηρῶν καὶ 【προφάσει】 μακρὰ προσευχόμενοι, οὗτοι λήμψονται περισσότερον κρίμα.
verses.LUK 20:47: οἳ κατεσθίουσιν τὰς οἰκίας τῶν χηρῶν καὶ 【προφάσει】 μακρὰ προσεύχονται· οὗτοι λήμψονται περισσότερον κρίμα.
verses.ACT 27:30: Τῶν δὲ ναυτῶν ζητούντων φυγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ πλοίου καὶ χαλασάντων τὴν σκάφην εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν 【προφάσει】 ὡς ἐκ πρῴρης ἀγκύρας μελλόντων ἐκτείνειν,
verses.PHP 1:18: τί γάρ; πλὴν ὅτι παντὶ τρόπῳ, εἴτε 【προφάσει】 εἴτε ἀληθείᾳ, Χριστὸς καταγγέλλεται, καὶ ἐν τούτῳ χαίρω· ἀλλὰ καὶ χαρήσομαι·
verses.1TH 2:5: οὔτε γάρ ποτε ἐν λόγῳ κολακίας ἐγενήθημεν, καθὼς οἴδατε, οὔτε ἐν 【προφάσει】 πλεονεξίας, Θεὸς μάρτυς,
verses.JHN 15:22: εἰ μὴ ἦλθον καὶ ἐλάλησα αὐτοῖς, ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ εἴχοσαν· νῦν δὲ 【πρόφασιν】 οὐκ ἔχουσιν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.

benchmark_ref.detail: a pretext, an excuse.

core_meaning_summary: To direct one's attention toward things or interests, to observe people closely, or to watch carefully lest something harmful occur.

senses.definition: To direct one's attention, focus, or concern toward specific realities or interests.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active participle with neuter plural articular direct objects (τὰ βλεπόμενα, τὰ ἑαυτῶν, etc.) in μὴ ... ἀλλά contrasts

senses.definition: To observe carefully or keep watch on people, either to guard against and avoid them or to follow their example.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active infinitive or imperative with accusative plural personal object (τούς + participle)

senses.definition: To examine carefully or keep guard over oneself so that an undesirable condition does not happen.
senses.grammatical_frame: Active imperative or participle followed by a cautionary μή ('lest') clause, with or without reflexive object σεαυτόν

collocations_and_notes: In 2CO 4:18 and PHP 2:4, used in negated-and-contrasted pairs (μὴ ... ἀλλά) to redirect attention from visible/self-focused concerns to unseen/others-focused ones. In ROM 16:17 and PHP 3:17, governs an articular participle denoting a group of people characterized by specific conduct, either to avoid (ROM 16:17) or to imitate (PHP 3:17). In LUK 11:35 and GAL 6:1, pairs with a warning clause introduced by μή ('lest').

verses.2CO 4:18: μὴ 【σκοπούντων】 ἡμῶν τὰ βλεπόμενα ἀλλὰ τὰ μὴ βλεπόμενα· τὰ γὰρ βλεπόμενα πρόσκαιρα, τὰ δὲ μὴ βλεπόμενα αἰώνια.
verses.PHP 2:4: μὴ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ἕκαστοι 【σκοποῦντες,】 ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἑτέρων ἕκαστοι.
verses.ROM 16:17: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, 【σκοπεῖν】 τοὺς τὰς διχοστασίας καὶ τὰ σκάνδαλα παρὰ τὴν διδαχὴν ἣν ὑμεῖς ἐμάθετε ποιοῦντας, καὶ ἐκκλίνετε ἀπ’ αὐτῶν·
verses.PHP 3:17: Συνμιμηταί μου γίνεσθε, ἀδελφοί, καὶ 【σκοπεῖτε】 τοὺς οὕτως περιπατοῦντας καθὼς ἔχετε τύπον ἡμᾶς.
verses.LUK 11:35: 【σκόπει】 οὖν μὴ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἐν σοὶ σκότος ἐστίν.
verses.GAL 6:1: Ἀδελφοί, ἐὰν καὶ προλημφθῇ ἄνθρωπος ἔν τινι παραπτώματι, ὑμεῖς οἱ πνευματικοὶ καταρτίζετε τὸν τοιοῦτον ἐν πνεύματι πραΰτητος, 【σκοπῶν】 σεαυτόν, μὴ καὶ σὺ πειρασθῇς.

benchmark_ref.detail: I look at, regard attentively, take heed, beware, consider.

core_meaning_summary: An athletic contest or intense struggle involving strenuous exertion, endurance, or opposition.

senses.definition: A competitive contest or race requiring sustained discipline and endurance, used metaphorically for persevering in faith.
senses.grammatical_frame: noun (accusative); cognate object of ἀγωνίζομαι or object of τρέχω

senses.definition: An intense struggle, conflict, or strenuous exertion endured amid opposition or on behalf of others.
senses.grammatical_frame: noun (accusative as object of ἔχω, or dative after ἐν)

collocations_and_notes: Frequently appears as the direct object of verbs of possessing (ἔχω, PHP 1:30; COL 2:1), competing (cognate verb ἀγωνίζομαι, 1TI 6:12; 2TI 4:7), or running (τρέχω, HEB 12:1). In 1TI 6:12 and 2TI 4:7 it forms the set phrase τὸν καλὸν ἀγῶνα, and in 2TI 4:7 and HEB 12:1 it stands alongside footrace imagery (δρόμος, τρέχω). In 1TH 2:2 ἐν πολλῷ ἀγῶνι describes intense external opposition and hardship accompanying preaching after prior mistreatment.

verses.1TI 6:12: ἀγωνίζου τὸν καλὸν 【ἀγῶνα】 τῆς πίστεως, ἐπιλαβοῦ τῆς αἰωνίου ζωῆς, εἰς ἣν ἐκλήθης καὶ ὡμολόγησας τὴν καλὴν ὁμολογίαν ἐνώπιον πολλῶν μαρτύρων.
verses.2TI 4:7: τὸν καλὸν 【ἀγῶνα】 ἠγώνισμαι, τὸν δρόμον τετέλεκα, τὴν πίστιν τετήρηκα·
verses.HEB 12:1: Τοιγαροῦν καὶ ἡμεῖς, τοσοῦτον ἔχοντες περικείμενον ἡμῖν νέφος μαρτύρων, ὄγκον ἀποθέμενοι πάντα καὶ τὴν εὐπερίστατον ἁμαρτίαν, δι’ ὑπομονῆς τρέχωμεν τὸν προκείμενον ἡμῖν 【ἀγῶνα,】
verses.PHP 1:30: τὸν αὐτὸν 【ἀγῶνα】 ἔχοντες οἷον εἴδετε ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ νῦν ἀκούετε ἐν ἐμοί.
verses.COL 2:1: Θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ἡλίκον 【ἀγῶνα】 ἔχω ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικίᾳ καὶ ὅσοι οὐχ ἑόρακαν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐν σαρκί,
verses.1TH 2:2: ἀλλὰ προπαθόντες καὶ ὑβρισθέντες καθὼς οἴδατε ἐν Φιλίπποις ἐπαρρησιασάμεθα ἐν τῷ Θεῷ ἡμῶν λαλῆσαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν πολλῷ 【ἀγῶνι.】

benchmark_ref.detail: an (athletic) contest; hence, a struggle (in the soul).

core_meaning_summary: To fill up a deficiency, occupy a position, or bring a prophecy, obligation, or measure to completion.

senses.definition: To supply what is missing or make up for another's absence or shortfall in service.
senses.grammatical_frame: active verb + accusative (τὸ ὑστέρημα)

senses.definition: To occupy or fill a particular role, position, or status in a gathering.
senses.grammatical_frame: active participle + accusative (τὸν τόπον + genitive)

senses.definition: To bring a spoken prophecy or moral obligation to full realization or obedience.
senses.grammatical_frame: passive with ἡ προφητεία as subject, or active + accusative (τὸν νόμον)

senses.definition: To fill up the measure of wrongdoing to its full limit.
senses.grammatical_frame: active infinitive (εἰς τὸ + inf) + accusative (τὰς ἁμαρτίας)

collocations_and_notes: Takes varied direct objects depending on context: ὑστέρημα ("what is lacking", 1CO 16:17; PHP 2:30), τόπος ("place/role", 1CO 14:16), νόμος ("law", GAL 6:2), and ἁμαρτίαι ("sins", 1TH 2:16). In MAT 13:14 it appears in the passive with ἡ προφητεία as subject and a dative of reference (αὐτοῖς).

verses.1CO 16:17: χαίρω δὲ ἐπὶ τῇ παρουσίᾳ Στεφανᾶ καὶ Φορτουνάτου καὶ Ἀχαϊκοῦ, ὅτι τὸ ὑμέτερον ὑστέρημα οὗτοι 【ἀνεπλήρωσαν·】
verses.PHP 2:30: ὅτι διὰ τὸ ἔργον Χριστοῦ μέχρι θανάτου ἤγγισεν παραβολευσάμενος τῇ ψυχῇ, ἵνα 【ἀναπληρώσῃ】 τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα τῆς πρός με λειτουργίας.
verses.1CO 14:16: ἐπεὶ ἐὰν εὐλογῇς πνεύματι, ὁ 【ἀναπληρῶν】 τὸν τόπον τοῦ ἰδιώτου πῶς ἐρεῖ τὸ Ἀμήν ἐπὶ τῇ σῇ εὐχαριστίᾳ; ἐπειδὴ τί λέγεις οὐκ οἶδεν·
verses.MAT 13:14: καὶ 【ἀναπληροῦται】 αὐτοῖς ἡ προφητεία Ἡσαΐου ἡ λέγουσα Ἀκοῇ ἀκούσετε καὶ οὐ μὴ συνῆτε, καὶ βλέποντες βλέψετε καὶ οὐ μὴ ἴδητε.
verses.GAL 6:2: Ἀλλήλων τὰ βάρη βαστάζετε, καὶ οὕτως 【ἀναπληρώσετε】 τὸν νόμον τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.1TH 2:16: κωλυόντων ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἔθνεσιν λαλῆσαι ἵνα σωθῶσιν, εἰς τὸ 【ἀναπληρῶσαι】 αὐτῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας πάντοτε. ἔφθασεν δὲ ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ἡ ὀργὴ εἰς τέλος.

glosses: I fill up, make up, fulfill
benchmark_ref.detail: I fill up, make up, complete the measure of, fulfill, carry out the commands (provisions, etc.) of.

core_meaning_summary: In a manner fitting, appropriate, or corresponding in value and character to someone or something.

senses.definition: In a way that matches and honors the character, calling, or standard of the person or message named in the genitive.
senses.grammatical_frame: adverb + genitive, modifying verbs of conduct (περιπατέω, πολιτεύομαι)

senses.definition: With honor, care, and hospitality appropriate to God's character or to the community of believers.
senses.grammatical_frame: adverb + genitive, modifying verbs of receiving or sending travelers (προσδέχομαι, προπέμπω)

collocations_and_notes: Regularly governs a genitive specifying the person, calling, or standard to which the action corresponds (τῶν ἁγίων, τῆς κλήσεως, τοῦ εὐαγγελίου, τοῦ Κυρίου, τοῦ Θεοῦ). Most commonly modifies verbs denoting a way of life (περιπατέω in EPH 4:1; COL 1:10; 1TH 2:12; πολιτεύομαι in PHP 1:27).

verses.EPH 4:1: Παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ ὁ δέσμιος ἐν Κυρίῳ 【ἀξίως】 περιπατῆσαι τῆς κλήσεως ἧς ἐκλήθητε,
verses.PHP 1:27: Μόνον 【ἀξίως】 τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τοῦ Χριστοῦ πολιτεύεσθε, ἵνα εἴτε ἐλθὼν καὶ ἰδὼν ὑμᾶς εἴτε ἀπὼν ἀκούω τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν, ὅτι στήκετε ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι, μιᾷ ψυχῇ συναθλοῦντες τῇ πίστει τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,

core_meaning_summary: Without delay; at once or at that very moment.

senses.definition: Immediately, without intervening delay, or right at a specified moment.
senses.grammatical_frame: temporal adverb modifying a finite verb, participle, or infinitive

collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired with verbs of sending (ἔπεμψα in ACT 10:33; ACT 23:30; πέμψαι in PHP 2:23). In MRK 6:25 it reinforces a demand already marked by εὐθὺς μετὰ σπουδῆς, and in ACT 11:11 it follows καὶ ἰδού to highlight sudden arrival at that exact moment. In PHP 2:23 it stands at the end of a conditional-temporal clause (ὡς ἂν ἀφίδω τὰ περὶ ἐμὲ ἐξαυτῆς) to express prompt action once the outcome is known.

verses.MRK 6:25: καὶ εἰσελθοῦσα εὐθὺς μετὰ σπουδῆς πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ᾐτήσατο λέγουσα Θέλω ἵνα 【ἐξαυτῆς】 δῷς μοι ἐπὶ πίνακι τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἰωάνου τοῦ Βαπτιστοῦ.
verses.ACT 10:33: 【ἐξαυτῆς】 οὖν ἔπεμψα πρὸς σέ, σύ τε καλῶς ἐποίησας παραγενόμενος. νῦν οὖν πάντες ἡμεῖς ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ πάρεσμεν ἀκοῦσαι πάντα τὰ προστεταγμένα σοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου.
verses.ACT 11:11: καὶ ἰδοὺ 【ἐξαυτῆς】 τρεῖς ἄνδρες ἐπέστησαν ἐπὶ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐν ᾗ ἦμεν, ἀπεσταλμένοι ἀπὸ Καισαρίας πρός με.
verses.ACT 21:32: ὃς 【ἐξαυτῆς】 παραλαβὼν στρατιώτας καὶ ἑκατοντάρχας κατέδραμεν ἐπ’ αὐτούς· οἱ δὲ ἰδόντες τὸν χιλίαρχον καὶ τοὺς στρατιώτας ἐπαύσαντο τύπτοντες τὸν Παῦλον.
verses.ACT 23:30: μηνυθείσης δέ μοι ἐπιβουλῆς εἰς τὸν ἄνδρα ἔσεσθαι, 【ἐξαυτῆς】 ἔπεμψα πρὸς σέ, παραγγείλας καὶ τοῖς κατηγόροις λέγειν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐπὶ σοῦ.
verses.PHP 2:23: Τοῦτον μὲν οὖν ἐλπίζω πέμψαι ὡς ἂν ἀφίδω τὰ περὶ ἐμὲ 【ἐξαυτῆς·】

benchmark_ref.detail: immediately, instantly, at once.

core_meaning_summary: A perceptible scent or fragrance, used both literally of perfumed ointment and figuratively of a spreading influence or a sacrifice pleasing to God.

senses.definition: The physical scent or fragrance given off by a fragrant substance such as perfumed ointment that fills an enclosed space.
senses.grammatical_frame: feminine noun after ἐκ + genitive, with genitive of source (τοῦ μύρου)

senses.definition: Figuratively, a perceptible spiritual influence or manifestation spread through messengers, producing either death or life among those who encounter it.
senses.grammatical_frame: feminine noun as direct object with abstract genitive (τῆς γνώσεως), or predicate nominative with ἐκ/εἰς prepositional phrases

senses.definition: Figuratively, a pleasing sacrificial fragrance representing a self-giving act or gift offered to God and accepted by him.
senses.grammatical_frame: feminine noun in the phrase ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας, after εἰς + accusative or in apposition to θυσίαν, with τῷ Θεῷ

collocations_and_notes: In JHN 12:3 it takes a concrete genitive (τοῦ μύρου, 'of the perfume') after ἐκ with πληρόω ('be filled from the scent'). In 2CO 2:14–16 it is used metaphorically with an abstract genitive (τῆς γνώσεως αὐτοῦ) and contrasting ἐκ ... εἰς phrases (ἐκ θανάτου εἰς θάνατον / ἐκ ζωῆς εἰς ζωήν). In EPH 5:2 and PHP 4:18 it forms the fixed collocation ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας ('fragrance of a sweet smell') paired explicitly with θυσία ('sacrifice') and προσφορά ('offering') directed toward God.

verses.JHN 12:3: ἡ οὖν Μαριὰμ λαβοῦσα λίτραν μύρου νάρδου πιστικῆς πολυτίμου ἤλειψεν τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐξέμαξεν ταῖς θριξὶν αὐτῆς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ· ἡ δὲ οἰκία ἐπληρώθη ἐκ τῆς 【ὀσμῆς】 τοῦ μύρου.
verses.2CO 2:14: Τῷ δὲ Θεῷ χάρις τῷ πάντοτε θριαμβεύοντι ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ καὶ τὴν 【ὀσμὴν】 τῆς γνώσεως αὐτοῦ φανεροῦντι δι’ ἡμῶν ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ·
verses.2CO 2:16: οἷς μὲν 【ὀσμὴ】 ἐκ θανάτου εἰς θάνατον, οἷς δὲ 【ὀσμὴ】 ἐκ ζωῆς εἰς ζωήν. καὶ πρὸς ταῦτα τίς ἱκανός;
verses.EPH 5:2: καὶ περιπατεῖτε ἐν ἀγάπῃ, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν ὑμᾶς καὶ παρέδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν προσφορὰν καὶ θυσίαν τῷ Θεῷ εἰς 【ὀσμὴν】 εὐωδίας.
verses.PHP 4:18: ἀπέχω δὲ πάντα καὶ περισσεύω· πεπλήρωμαι δεξάμενος παρὰ Ἐπαφροδίτου τὰ παρ’ ὑμῶν, 【ὀσμὴν】 εὐωδίας, θυσίαν δεκτήν, εὐάρεστον τῷ Θεῷ.

benchmark_ref.detail: a smell, odor, savor.

core_meaning_summary: A visible form, crafted representation, shared outward condition, or structural correspondence between one entity or event and another.

senses.definition: The visible form, appearance, or crafted representation of living creatures or visionary beings.
senses.grammatical_frame: neuter noun (singular after ἐν + dative with genitive εἰκόνος, or plural subject with genitive τῶν ἀκρίδων)

senses.definition: A shared human form, nature, or outward condition in which someone is sent or comes to be.
senses.grammatical_frame: neuter noun after ἐν + dative with genitive (σαρκὸς ἁμαρτίας, ἀνθρώπων)

senses.definition: A correspondence in pattern, manner, or counterpart to an earlier event or act such as transgression or death.
senses.grammatical_frame: neuter dative noun after ἐπὶ or as complement of σύμφυτοι, with genitive (τῆς παραβάσεως, τοῦ θανάτου)

collocations_and_notes: Frequently appears in prepositional phrases with ἐν + dative (ROM 1:23; ROM 8:3; PHP 2:7) or ἐπὶ + dative (ROM 5:14), and as a dative complement with σύμφυτοι (ROM 6:5). In ROM 1:23 it combines with εἰκόνος to denote an idolatrous representation; in PHP 2:7 it parallels μορφὴν δούλου and σχήματι; in REV 9:7 the plural τὰ ὁμοιώματα pairs with ὅμοιοι and ὡς to describe visionary appearances.

verses.ROM 1:23: καὶ ἤλλαξαν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ ἀφθάρτου Θεοῦ ἐν 【ὁμοιώματι】 εἰκόνος φθαρτοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ πετεινῶν καὶ τετραπόδων καὶ ἑρπετῶν.

verses.ROM 8:3: τὸ γὰρ ἀδύνατον τοῦ νόμου, ἐν ᾧ ἠσθένει διὰ τῆς σαρκός, ὁ Θεὸς τὸν ἑαυτοῦ Υἱὸν πέμψας ἐν 【ὁμοιώματι】 σαρκὸς ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας κατέκρινεν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἐν τῇ σαρκί,
verses.PHP 2:7: ἀλλὰ ἑαυτὸν ἐκένωσεν μορφὴν δούλου λαβών, ἐν 【ὁμοιώματι】 ἀνθρώπων γενόμενος· καὶ σχήματι εὑρεθεὶς ὡς ἄνθρωπος
verses.ROM 5:14: ἀλλὰ ἐβασίλευσεν ὁ θάνατος ἀπὸ Ἀδὰμ μέχρι Μωϋσέως καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς μὴ ἁμαρτήσαντας ἐπὶ τῷ 【ὁμοιώματι】 τῆς παραβάσεως Ἀδάμ, ὅς ἐστιν τύπος τοῦ μέλλοντος.
verses.ROM 6:5: εἰ γὰρ σύμφυτοι γεγόναμεν τῷ 【ὁμοιώματι】 τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ καὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως ἐσόμεθα·

benchmark_ref.detail: (originally: a thing made like something else), a likeness, or rather: form; a similitude.

core_meaning_summary: Proper name of Thessalonica, a city in Macedonia with a Jewish synagogue and Christian community.

senses.grammatical_frame: Proper noun, feminine singular governed by prepositions εἰς, ἐν, or ἀπό
senses.definition: Thessalonica, a Macedonian city visited by Paul where he received aid from the Philippians.

collocations_and_notes: Connected geographically with Amphipolis, Apollonia, and Beroea (ACT 17:1, 13) and mentioned as the place where the Philippians repeatedly sent aid to Paul (PHP 4:16).

verses.ACT 17:1: Διοδεύσαντες δὲ τὴν Ἀμφίπολιν καὶ τὴν Ἀπολλωνίαν ἦλθον εἰς 【Θεσσαλονίκην,】 ὅπου ἦν συναγωγὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων.
verses.ACT 17:11: οὗτοι δὲ ἦσαν εὐγενέστεροι τῶν ἐν 【Θεσσαλονίκῃ,】 οἵτινες ἐδέξαντο τὸν λόγον μετὰ πάσης προθυμίας, τὸ καθ’ ἡμέραν ἀνακρίνοντες τὰς γραφὰς εἰ ἔχοι ταῦτα οὕτως.
verses.ACT 17:13: Ὡς δὲ ἔγνωσαν οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς 【Θεσσαλονίκης】 Ἰουδαῖοι ὅτι καὶ ἐν τῇ Βεροίᾳ κατηγγέλη ὑπὸ τοῦ Παύλου ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἦλθον κἀκεῖ σαλεύοντες καὶ ταράσσοντες τοὺς ὄχλους.

core_meaning_summary: In the middle/passive, to feel ashamed of something or to be put to shame and disgraced.

senses.grammatical_frame: Verb, present middle/passive indicative or imperative, with infinitive (ἐπαιτεῖν) or conditional role (ὡς Χριστιανός)
senses.definition: To feel embarrassment or shame over an action or identity.

senses.grammatical_frame: Verb, future or aorist passive (οὐκ αἰσχυνθήσομαι; μὴ αἰσχυνθῶμεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ), contrasted with παρρησία ('boldness')
senses.definition: To be put to shame, disgraced, or disappointed in one's hope or confidence.

collocations_and_notes: Contrasted with παρρησία ('boldness/confidence') in PHP 1:20 and 1JN 2:28, and with δοξαζέτω δὲ τὸν Θεόν in 1PE 4:16.

verses.LUK 16:3: εἶπεν δὲ ἐν ἑαυτῷ ὁ οἰκονόμος Τί ποιήσω, ὅτι ὁ κύριός μου ἀφαιρεῖται τὴν οἰκονομίαν ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ; σκάπτειν οὐκ ἰσχύω, ἐπαιτεῖν 【αἰσχύνομαι.】
verses.1PE 4:16: εἰ δὲ ὡς Χριστιανός, μὴ 【αἰσχυνέσθω,】 δοξαζέτω δὲ τὸν Θεὸν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ.
verses.2CO 10:8: ἐάν τε γὰρ περισσότερόν τι καυχήσωμαι περὶ τῆς ἐξουσίας ἡμῶν, ἧς ἔδωκεν ὁ Κύριος εἰς οἰκοδομὴν καὶ οὐκ εἰς καθαίρεσιν ὑμῶν, οὐκ 【αἰσχυνθήσομαι,】
verses.PHP 1:20: κατὰ τὴν ἀποκαραδοκίαν καὶ ἐλπίδα μου ὅτι ἐν οὐδενὶ 【αἰσχυνθήσομαι,】 ἀλλ’ ἐν πάσῃ παρρησίᾳ ὡς πάντοτε καὶ νῦν μεγαλυνθήσεται Χριστὸς ἐν τῷ σώματί μου, εἴτε διὰ ζωῆς εἴτε διὰ θανάτου.

senses.grammatical_frame: Adjective describing a prophet, person, or sacrifice, often with dative αὐτῷ / τῷ Θεῷ
senses.definition: Welcomed, approved, or pleasing to a community or to God.

senses.grammatical_frame: Adjective modifying time nouns (ἐνιαυτὸν Κυρίου δεκτόν; καιρῷ δεκτῷ)
senses.definition: Favorable or chosen as a season of divine grace and deliverance.

collocations_and_notes: Glossed by εὐπρόσδεκτος ('well-accepted/favorable') in 2CO 6:2 and paired with εὐάρεστον τῷ Θεῷ in θυσίαν δεκτήν (PHP 4:18).

verses.PHP 4:18: ἀπέχω δὲ πάντα καὶ περισσεύω· πεπλήρωμαι δεξάμενος παρὰ Ἐπαφροδίτου τὰ παρ’ ὑμῶν, ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας, θυσίαν 【δεκτήν,】 εὐάρεστον τῷ Θεῷ.
verses.2CO 6:2: —λέγει γάρ Καιρῷ 【δεκτῷ】 ἐπήκουσά σου καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ σωτηρίας ἐβοήθησά σοι· ἰδοὺ νῦν καιρὸς εὐπρόσδεκτος, ἰδοὺ νῦν ἡμέρα σωτηρίας·—

benchmark_ref.detail: acceptable, accepted.

core_meaning_summary: Concessive conjunction introducing a participle to mean 'although' or 'even though.'

senses.grammatical_frame: Concessive particle/conjunction always followed by a participle (ἔχων, ὤν, ἐξεληλυθότας, ἐκζητήσας, εἰδότας)
senses.definition: Marks a fact or circumstance in spite of which the main clause holds true.

collocations_and_notes: Consistently introduces a concessive participial phrase (e.g., καίπερ ὢν Υἱός, HEB 5:8; καίπερ ἐγὼ ἔχων πεποίθησιν, PHP 3:4).

verses.2PE 1:12: Διὸ μελλήσω ἀεὶ ὑμᾶς ὑπομιμνῄσκειν περὶ τούτων, 【καίπερ】 εἰδότας καὶ ἐστηριγμένους ἐν τῇ παρούσῃ ἀληθείᾳ.

benchmark_ref.detail: although, though.

core_meaning_summary: To make empty, void, or ineffective, or reflexively to empty oneself of status.

senses.grammatical_frame: Verb, active or passive with abstract subjects/objects (ἡ πίστις, ὁ σταυρὸς τοῦ Χριστοῦ, τὸ καύχημα)
senses.definition: To render hollow, void, or devoid of force and validity.

senses.grammatical_frame: Verb, aorist active indicative with reflexive object ἑαυτόν, elaborated by modal participles (μορφὴν δούλου λαβών)
senses.definition: To empty oneself by voluntarily laying aside privilege and taking a lowly condition.

verses.2CO 9:3: ἔπεμψα δὲ τοὺς ἀδελφούς, ἵνα μὴ τὸ καύχημα ἡμῶν τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν 【κενωθῇ】 ἐν τῷ μέρει τούτῳ, ἵνα καθὼς ἔλεγον παρεσκευασμένοι ἦτε,
verses.PHP 2:7: ἀλλὰ ἑαυτὸν 【ἐκένωσεν】 μορφὴν δούλου λαβών, ἐν ὁμοιώματι ἀνθρώπων γενόμενος· καὶ σχήματι εὑρεθεὶς ὡς ἄνθρωπος

core_meaning_summary: A dog (scavenger animal), or figuratively a derogatory term for impure or dangerous people.

senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, masculine singular or plural referring to literal scavenging animals
senses.definition: A dog, depicted as an unclean scavenger or street animal.

senses.grammatical_frame: Noun, masculine plural used polemically of dangerous opponents or excluded evildoers
senses.definition: Figurative label of contempt for harmful, morally impure, or excluded persons.

verses.REV 22:15: ἔξω οἱ 【κύνες】 καὶ οἱ φάρμακοι καὶ οἱ πόρνοι καὶ οἱ φονεῖς καὶ οἱ εἰδωλολάτραι καὶ πᾶς φιλῶν καὶ ποιῶν ψεῦδος.

core_meaning_summary: A public servant, cultic/spiritual minister of God, or commissioned envoy meeting someone's needs.

core_meaning_summary: To transform in form/condition, to disguise oneself, or to apply a figure to oneself.

core_meaning_summary: Compassion, mercy, or pity shown by God or between people.

benchmark_ref.detail: (used as an official title in civil life), overseer, supervisor, ruler, especially used with reference to the supervising function exercised by an elder or presbyter of a church or congregation.

core_meaning_summary: Honored, highly regarded, or precious in value and rank.

senses.grammatical_frame: Adjective (positive or comparative ἐντιμότερος), predicate with εἶναι / ἔχειν or dative of esteem (αὐτῷ)
senses.definition: Highly regarded, dear, or honored in status and esteem among people.

benchmark_ref.detail: (held precious, hence) precious, honored, honorable in rank.

core_meaning_summary: To hold superior authority or rank, or to surpass in excellence or exceed comprehension.

senses.grammatical_frame: Verb, present active participle (ὑπερεχούσαις, ὑπερέχοντι, ὑπερέχοντας) modifying rulers/authorities or with genitive of comparison (ἑαυτῶν)
senses.definition: To be above others in rank, governing authority, or personal regard.

senses.grammatical_frame: Verb, neuter participle substantive (τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως) or active participle governing accusative πάντα νοῦν
senses.definition: To surpass in worth or exceed the limits of human understanding.

collocations_and_notes: Applied to civil rulers in ἐξουσίαις ὑπερεχούσαις (ROM 13:1) and βασιλεῖ ὡς ὑπερέχοντι (1PE 2:13); substantivized in τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ (PHP 3:8); governs πάντα νοῦν in PHP 4:7.

core_meaning_summary: Discontented grumbling or complaining, or hushed murmured discussion among a crowd.

senses.definition: Hushed, divided murmuring or whispered talk among a crowd.

core_meaning_summary: Material damage or loss, or spiritual/personal forfeit contrasted with gain.

senses.definition: Material loss, damage, or harm to cargo, ship, and human lives.

core_meaning_summary: To bend or bow the knee in worship, prayer, or homage.

core_meaning_summary: To share in or participate together with others in actions, sins, or hardships.

uncertainty_note: Occurs only twice; both legal-argumentative contexts converge cleanly on 'confirmation/validation,' though limited attestation leaves finer institutional or legal nuances unexamined.

uncertainty_note: Occurs only once; contrast with τὰ ὀπίσω ἐπιλανθανόμενος and link to οὔπω ... κατειληφέναι clearly indicate intense forward straining, though one occurrence leaves open whether the image is specifically a runner leaning toward the finish or general stretching out.

collocations_and_notes: Exhibits conditioned phonological variants in the pointing: most commonly וְ, becoming וּ before labial consonants or initial consonant clusters with vocal shewa (e.g., GEN 46:31; NUM 2:22; 1CH 7:34) and before certain initial syllables (e.g., NEH 7:9; PSA 107:3), וִ before yod with shewa (1CH 25:6) or composite shewa/gutteral patterns (2KI 18:32), וָ in accented word-pairs such as יִרְאָה וָרַעַד (PSA 55:6), וָמֵת / וָחָי (DEU 19:5), and first-person singular narrative sequential verbs (DAN 8:27), and וַ with gemination of the following prefix consonant in third/second/plural narrative sequential verbs (e.g., GEN 18:10; EXO 32:31; 1SA 6:13) as well as before אֲשֶׁר/אֲנִי/אֲרָם (DEU 19:5; EZK 13:22; DAN 8:27; 1CH 7:34). Common fixed pairings include בֵּין ... וּבֵין ('between ... and', EXO 14:2; JOS 22:27), מִן ... וְעַד ('from ... even to', JON 3:5), וְעַתָּה ('and now', 2SA 7:29), וְהִנֵּה ('and behold', GEN 18:10), וְכִי ('and if/when', LEV 11:37), and וְאִם ('and/but if', JDG 13:16).

core_meaning_summary: Independent third-person masculine singular pronoun and bound pronominal suffix series indicating person, number, and gender across nominal, prepositional, and verbal hosts.

senses.definition: Independent third-person masculine singular pronoun functioning as the grammatical subject or emphatic resumptive subject of a nominal or verbal clause.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent 3ms pronoun standing as clause subject or resumptive subject before a predicate

senses.definition: Independent third-person masculine singular pronoun preceded by the definite article, modifying a preceding definite noun to point to a specific, non-immediate referent.
senses.grammatical_frame: Independent 3ms pronoun prefixed with ha- following a definite noun in apposition

senses.definition: Bound pronominal suffix attached to a singular or plural noun in the construct state to express possession, kinship, or relational association (attested in this corpus's lemmatization across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd person forms).
senses.grammatical_frame: Pronominal suffix attached to singular or plural nouns

senses.definition: Bound pronominal suffix attached to prepositions or the definite direct-object marker ʾēṯ to indicate the indirect, prepositional, or direct object participant (attested across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd person forms).
senses.grammatical_frame: Pronominal suffix attached to prepositions (e.g., l-, b-, ʾel, ʿal, ʾēṯ/ʿim) or the object marker ʾēṯ

senses.definition: Bound pronominal suffix attached directly to a finite verb or infinitive construct to mark its direct object (attested across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd person forms).
senses.grammatical_frame: Pronominal suffix attached directly to finite verb forms or infinitives construct

collocations_and_notes: In this corpus's lemmatization, both the independent third-person masculine singular pronoun (hûʾ) and bound pronominal suffixes across persons, numbers, and genders are grouped under this headword. Independent hûʾ frequently serves for topic/focus emphasis in nominal clauses (e.g., JOS 23:3) or as a distal demonstrative with the definite article in temporal expressions (bayyôm hahûʾ, 1SA 10:9). Bound suffixes vary morphologically by person, number, gender, and host stem (e.g., -ô / -āyw / -êhû for 3ms, -āh for 3fs, -hem / -ām for 3mp, -ḵā / -ēḵ / -ḵem for 2nd person, -î / -nî / -nû for 1st person).

core_meaning_summary: Proclitic definite article marking specific, known, or contextually identified nouns, substantivized expressions, and their agreeing modifiers.

senses.definition: Prefixed to a common noun to identify a specific, previously introduced, unique, or contextually understood entity, group, place, or material.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic article prefixed directly to singular or plural common nouns

senses.definition: Prefixed to an attributive adjective, ordinal numeral, or demonstrative pronoun to mark agreement in definiteness with a preceding definite or possessed noun.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic article prefixed to post-nominal modifiers agreeing with a definite or suffixed head noun

senses.definition: Prefixed to a participle or adjective to introduce a substantivized agent, group, or concept, or a restrictive descriptive clause referring back to a definite noun.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic article prefixed to participles, adjectives, or numerals used substantively or as relative modifiers

senses.definition: Prefixed to a gentilic or ethnic designation to refer collectively to a people group or specifically to an individual by origin.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic article prefixed to gentilic nouns (singular collective or plural)

senses.definition: Prefixed to the noun 'day' (yôm) in temporal expressions denoting the present day or a particular narrative day.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic article prefixed to yôm in adverbial or clause-initial temporal constructions

collocations_and_notes: Vocalization shifts conditioned by the initial consonant of the host word: typically ha- with doubling of the following consonant (e.g., haššāmayim, hammeleḵ), lengthening to hā- before non-doubling gutturals or rēš (e.g., hāʾāreṣ, hāʿām, hārōʾš), and dissimilating to he- before certain gutturals with qāmeṣ (e.g., hehārîm in JER 4:24 and MIC 1:4; heḥāy in 1KI 3:23). Frequently recurs in fixed phrases such as bayyôm hahûʾ ('on that day', 1SA 14:31, ISA 22:12), bāʿēṯ hahîʾ ('at that time', 2CH 16:7), and in vocative or identificatory apposition (e.g., ʾattâ hāʾēl, 'you are the God', PSA 77:15).

core_meaning_summary: Inseparable preposition marking recipient, beneficiary, possession, purpose or infinitival complement, resultant state, spatial or temporal orientation, and specification.

senses.definition: Marks the recipient, addressee, beneficiary, or affected party of an action or utterance, including reflexive self-reference or personal involvement with verbs of motion and action.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before a personal noun, deity name, or pronominal suffix functioning as indirect object or beneficiary
senses.semantic_domain: Recipient, Beneficiary, and Direction of Action

senses.definition: Expresses ownership, belonging, social or official allegiance, or topical reference ('as for').
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition in verbless/relative clauses of possession (e.g., אֲשֶׁר לוֹ, מַה לִּי וָלָךְ) or clause-initial topic phrases

senses.definition: Indicates purpose, intended goal, or verbal complement, most commonly prefixed to an infinitive construct (including לֵאמֹר to introduce speech and לְבִלְתִּי for negative purpose).
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before an infinitive construct (or negated לְבִלְתִּי) or a noun of goal/task

senses.definition: Marks a resulting state, status, role, or transformation, especially with verbs of being, becoming, or cultic acceptance.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition introducing a predicative complement after verbs such as הָיָה or רָצָה

senses.definition: Marks spatial direction, orientation, or temporal limit, frequently in compound prepositions with body-part or relational nouns ('before', 'in front of', 'to meet', 'apart from', 'beyond').
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before directional nouns, time terms, or relational nouns forming compound prepositions

senses.definition: Marks specification, manner or degree, distributive apportionment/ratio, or the object of verbs of calling or naming.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before measure/quantity nouns, manner idioms (e.g., לְפִי חֶרֶב, לָרֹב), or the complement of קָרָא

collocations_and_notes: Attaches directly as a proclitic prefix (l-, lā-, la-, le-, li-) before nouns, pronouns, and infinitives construct. Extremely frequent with verbs of speaking (e.g., לֵאמֹר introducing direct discourse), giving, and swearing; often forms compound prepositions such as לִפְנֵי ('before / in front of'), לִקְרַאת ('to meet'), and לְבַד מִן ('apart from'). With verbs of motion or personal action, pronominal suffixes (e.g., לְךָ, לִי) often function reflexively or highlight the subject's personal involvement.

core_meaning_summary: Inseparable preposition marking spatial location, temporal setting, means or instrument, attendant circumstance, association, and various verbal complements.

senses.definition: Marks spatial position, containment, surface contact, distribution across an area, or entry into a sphere of control (e.g., into someone's hand).
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before a noun, demonstrative, or pronominal suffix denoting place, region, body part, or sphere of control

senses.definition: Indicates inclusion or presence within a group or company of people.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before a plural noun denoting a group or class of persons

senses.definition: Marks a point in time, a span or season, or a contemporaneous action when prefixed to an infinitive construct.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before a temporal noun, life-stage term, or infinitive construct

senses.definition: Identifies the instrument, means, agentive intermediary, authority, or price by which an action or transaction takes place.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before a noun denoting an instrument, force, intermediary (e.g., hand, word), commodity, or an infinitive construct

senses.definition: Expresses an attendant condition, state, event, or underlying ground or cause.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition before an abstract noun or event noun denoting a state, emotion, offense, or situation

senses.definition: Marks the evaluative standpoint in idioms with 'eyes', a partitive object with eating, or the target/complement of verbs such as trusting, looking upon, or executing judgment.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proclitic preposition in construct phrase 'in the eyes of' or as a required verbal complement

collocations_and_notes: Attaches directly as a proclitic prefix to nouns, pronouns, demonstratives, and infinitives construct, often assimilating the definite article vowel (ba-, bā-, be-). Common fixed phrases in the sample include בְּעֵינֵי ('in the eyes of', expressing perspective or evaluation), בְּיַד ('by the hand of' / 'into the hand of', expressing agency, supervision, or control), בְּתוֹךְ ('in the midst of'), and בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא / בָּעֵת הַהִוא ('in that day / at that time'). With infinitives construct, it routinely frames contemporaneous or immediately preceding events.

core_meaning_summary: Functions primarily as the grammatical marker of a definite direct object (and pronominal object carrier), and also as a preposition expressing accompaniment or association ('with').

senses.definition: Unleksicalized grammatical particle marking a definite noun phrase (with article, construct modifier, possessive suffix, or proper name) or relative clause as the direct object of an active transitive verb or infinitive, whether post-verbal or fronted.
senses.grammatical_frame: particle + definite noun phrase or relative clause (ʾăšer) with transitive verb or infinitive

senses.definition: Serves as the pronominal carrier (ʾōṯ-/ʾôṯ-/ʾeṯ- + suffix) expressing a definite pronominal direct object of a transitive verb or infinitive, used post-verbally, fronted for contrast, or resumptively.
senses.grammatical_frame: particle + pronominal suffix with transitive verb or infinitive

senses.definition: Marks the patient/grammatical subject of a passive (Niphal) verb, or introduces a fronted topicalized noun phrase resumed later in the clause by a prepositional pronoun.
senses.grammatical_frame: particle + definite noun phrase with passive verb (Niphal) or fronted topic construction

senses.definition: Preposition indicating spatial presence, companionship, shared participation in a state, or interpersonal addressee/interlocutor (with suffixal base ʾitt- or standalone/proclitic ʾeṯ-).
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition (ʾēṯ / ʾeṯ- / ʾitt-) + noun or pronominal suffix

collocations_and_notes: In this dataset, lemma_id 5408 encompasses both the definite direct object particle (proclitic ʾeṯ-, standalone ʾēṯ, and suffixal base ʾōṯ-/ʾôṯ-/ʾeṯ-) and the homographic preposition of accompaniment (standalone ʾēṯ, proclitic ʾeṯ-, and suffixal base ʾitt-). The object marker commonly introduces coordinated lists (GEN 15:19; JER 25:20), precedes relative clauses with ʾăšer (NUM 23:12; 2SA 19:36), and allows fronting of the object or topic before the verb (JOS 11:12; ISA 22:10; EZK 20:16). When a verb in the passive (Niphal) stem appears with ʾeṯ- (DEU 12:22), it marks the grammatical subject/patient. As a preposition of accompaniment, it pairs with verbs such as 'lie down' (2SA 7:12) and 'speak' (JER 7:22).

core_meaning_summary: A primary preposition indicating spatial departure or origin, separation or avoidance, partitive selection, temporal boundary, cause, or comparison.

senses.definition: Marks the spatial starting point, place of departure, or directional origin from which a person, object, or action proceeds.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun / demonstrative (often after verbs of motion)

senses.definition: Indicates separation, removal, deliverance, withholding, or turning away from a person, group, danger, burden, or moral state.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun (with verbs of removing, rescuing, turning, or separating)

senses.definition: Introduces an action from which someone is restrained, prevented, or turns back.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + infinitive construct

senses.definition: Denotes the personal, bodily, or authoritative source from which speech, descendants, dictation, judgment, or support originates.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun / pronominal suffix

senses.definition: Expresses a partitive relationship, identifying a portion, subset, or individual member drawn from a larger group, substance, or category.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + plural/collective noun or pronominal suffix

senses.definition: Combines with positional or relational prepositions (such as 'under', 'upon', or 'with') to specify relative location or detachment from someone's presence or control.
senses.grammatical_frame: compound preposition (min + taḥaṯ / ʿal / ʿim) + noun or suffix

senses.definition: Marks a temporal point or boundary, indicating either the completion of a time span ('at the end of') or the following day.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + temporal noun (qēṣ / māḥŏrāṯ)

senses.definition: Introduces a cause, threat, or lack that brings about a state or motivates a protective action, especially in compound forms with 'face' or 'without'.
senses.grammatical_frame: compound preposition (mippənê / mibbəlî) + noun or participle

senses.definition: Marks the standard of comparison in an elliptical comparative clause, indicating superiority or greater extent relative to another entity.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + proper noun (in comparative context)

collocations_and_notes: Frequently proclitic with assimilated nun (mi- + gemination, or mē- before gutturals/resh) and takes pronominal suffixes such as mimmennāh and mēhem. Forms common compound expressions with spatial/relational words: mittaḥaṯ lə- ('below'), mēʿal lə- ('above'), mēʿal ('away from / off'), mēʿim ('from with'), mippənê ('because of / against'), mibbəlî ('because of the lack of'), miqqēṣ ('at the end of'), mimmāḥŏrāṯ ('on the next day'). In JOB 5:5 it appears in the unusual combined sequence ʾel miṣṣinnîm ('even out from thorns'). In ISA 10:10 it functions elliptically in a comparison ('[greater] than Jerusalem and Samaria').

core_meaning_summary: The personal proper name of the God of Israel, depicted as creator, covenant speaker, ruler, deliverer, and judge.

senses.definition: Personal name of Israel's deity functioning as the active subject of speaking, commanding, creating, delivering, keeping covenant, and judging.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proper noun as grammatical subject of finite verbs or participles

senses.definition: Personal name of Israel's deity modifying a preceding noun in a construct relationship to indicate divine possession, agency, or association (such as his word, house, spirit, messenger, anger, or ark).
senses.grammatical_frame: Proper noun as genitival absolute in a construct chain

senses.definition: Personal name of Israel's deity used as the object of devotion, sacrifice, fear, vision, or offense, as well as in direct vocative prayer and oath formulas.
senses.grammatical_frame: Proper noun as direct object (with אֶת), prepositional object (לְ / מֵאֵת), vocative, or in oath formula חַי יְהוָה

collocations_and_notes: Frequently paired in apposition or construct with titles and descriptions such as יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים (GEN 2:4), יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם (DEU 20:18), יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם (JON 1:9), and יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת (ISA 14:23; ZEC 1:12). Appears regularly in prophetic and narrative introductory formulas (וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל, LEV 23:23; כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה, ISA 66:1; וַיְהִי דְבַר יְהוָה אֶל, JER 32:26; נְאֻם יְהוָה, ISA 14:23) and in the oath formula חַי יְהוָה ('as YHWH lives', 2SA 12:5). In the Masoretic vocalization of the sampled verses, it is usually pointed יְהוָה but occasionally יְהֹוָה (EXO 13:15; DEU 32:9; EZK 46:13).

core_meaning_summary: A primary preposition expressing spatial position above or upon a surface, proximity or orientation, authority over others, direction toward an affected target, causal ground, or addition and obligation.

senses.definition: Denotes physical location above, resting on, or in contact with the upper surface of an object, person, or expanse.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun phrase (spatial location/contact)

senses.definition: Marks spatial proximity alongside, facing before, or covering around an area or structure.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun phrase (proximity/orientation)

senses.definition: Combined with the prefix מִן (מֵעַל), marks separation or removal away from a surface or out of someone's presence.
senses.grammatical_frame: Compound preposition מֵעַל + noun or pronominal suffix

senses.definition: Indicates supervisory authority, royal rule, or administrative charge over people, offices, or property.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun/pronoun (with verbs of ruling or verbless predicate)

senses.definition: Introduces the recipient, target, or affected party of speech, commands, blessings, judgment, hostility, or directed action.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun/pronoun (complement of verbs of motion, speech, command, or hostility)

senses.definition: Marks the cause, basis, reason, or beneficiary motivating an emotion, ritual act, petition, or resulting state.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun phrase or demonstrative כֵּן (causal/benefactive)

senses.definition: Expresses addition alongside another item or a duty, guilt, or obligation resting upon someone.
senses.grammatical_frame: Preposition + noun/pronoun (with verbs of adding or verbless obligation clause)

collocations_and_notes: Frequently combines with body-part nouns in spatial or idiomatic phrases such as עַל פְּנֵי ('over/on the face/surface of', GEN 1:2; 'before/facing', 2KI 23:13), עַל פָּנֶיהָ ('on her face', RUT 2:10), עַל רֹאשׁ ('on the head of', GEN 47:31; LEV 4:29), עַל יָד/יָדַיִךְ ('on the hand/hands', JER 40:4; EZK 16:11), and עַל שִׁכְמוֹ ('on his shoulder', ISA 22:22). Forms the compound preposition מֵעַל ('from upon/off from', JOS 23:15; 'away from the presence of', 2SA 13:9) and the causal connector עַל כֵּן ('therefore, on account of this', LAM 3:21). Takes pronominal suffixes on an expanded stem עָלַי-/עָלֶי-/עָלָיו/עֲלֵיהֶם. In JER 23:35 it alternates in direct parallelism with אֶל ('to') as the addressee marker after the verb 'say'. In administrative contexts it frequently appears in verbless clauses marking oversight ('over', 1KI 4:5; 2KI 10:22).

core_meaning_summary: Preposition indicating spatial motion or direction toward a goal, the addressee of speech or communication, mental orientation or hostile directedness, and proximity or association.

senses.definition: Marks the spatial goal, destination, or endpoint of physical movement, gathering, sending, or casting.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun or pronominal suffix, following verbs of motion, sending, bringing, or gathering

senses.definition: Marks the addressee or recipient of spoken words, revelation, messages, or blessings.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + person/group, following verbs of speaking, revealing, or in verbless message/blessing formulas

senses.definition: Marks mental attention, moral heed, empowering descent, or directed action (often adverse) aimed at a person, command, or place.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun or pronominal suffix, following verbs of attention, listening, rushing (of spirit), bringing calamity, or setting the face

senses.definition: Indicates spatial proximity or static association/possession in relation to a person or group.
senses.grammatical_frame: preposition + noun or pronominal suffix, modifying a stative verb (הָיָה) or adjective of nearness (קָרוֹב)

collocations_and_notes: Takes pronominal suffixes on an expanded stem אֵלַי-/אֵלֶי-/אֲלֵי- (e.g., אֵלַי, אֵלֶיךָ, אֵלָיו, אֵלֶיהָ, אֲלֵיכֶם, אֲלֵיהֶם). Most frequently collocates with verbs of speaking (אָמַר, דִּבֶּר) to mark the addressee, and with verbs of motion (בּוֹא, הָלַךְ, שׁוּב, יָצָא, שָׁלַח, קָבַץ, טוּל) to mark the destination. In formulas of greeting or commission (e.g., JDG 3:19, PSA 129:8), it marks the intended recipient without an explicit verb of motion. Occasionally overlaps with adverse or hostile orientation ('upon, against') with verbs of bringing judgment or setting one's face (JER 35:17, EZK 4:3).

core_meaning_summary: Indeclinable relative particle and subordinating conjunction introducing relative clauses modifying a noun or pronoun, headless relative clauses, and adverbial or explanatory clauses of manner, time, or fact.

senses.definition: Relative marker introducing a dependent clause—either verbal or verbless with a prepositional predicate—that modifies or restricts an explicit nominal, pronominal, or personal antecedent.
senses.grammatical_frame: relative particle following an explicit noun, proper name, or pronoun antecedent, introducing a verbal or verbless clause

senses.definition: Independent relative marker introducing a headless clause functioning as a nominal constituent (subject or direct object), frequently preceded by כֹּל ('all').
senses.grammatical_frame: relative particle without an explicit noun antecedent, often after כֹּל, serving as subject or object of a matrix verb

senses.definition: Subordinating conjunction introducing clauses of manner, time, explanation, or event, especially in compounds with prepositions such as כְּ ('just as', 'when') and עַד ('until').
senses.grammatical_frame: subordinating conjunction (bare or compounded with prepositions כְּ or עַד) introducing an adverbial or factive clause

collocations_and_notes: Extremely frequent subordinating particle that is indeclinable across gender and number. Frequently prefixed with prepositions to form compound conjunctions, most commonly כַּאֲשֶׁר ('just as, according as' in LEV 8:9, DEU 2:22, 1KI 21:11, JER 39:12; temporally 'when' in JDG 3:18) and עַד אֲשֶׁר ('until' in JOS 1:15). Headless relative clauses frequently combine with כֹּל ('all that', e.g., GEN 34:29, 1SA 14:7, 1SA 30:19, 2KI 14:28). A resumptive pronoun may appear inside the relative clause when the antecedent is an object or indirect constituent (e.g., NUM 10:29). In verbless relative clauses, it regularly links a noun directly to a locative prepositional phrase (e.g., GEN 1:7, DEU 16:11, JOS 13:9, EZR 1:3, EST 3:2, ISA 37:2, EZK 40:44).

core_meaning_summary: Quantifier indicating the totality, entirety, or every individual instance of an entity, group, or domain.

senses.definition: Indicates the full extent or total membership of a specified group, region, period, or single entity without exception.
senses.grammatical_frame: Quantifier noun in construct before a definite plural, collective, or singular noun phrase

senses.definition: Indicates each individual member, case, or item belonging to a class without restriction.
senses.grammatical_frame: Quantifier noun in construct before an indefinite singular noun

senses.definition: Substantival quantifier referring to the entirety of a previously mentioned or specified set, either before a demonstrative or relative clause or carrying a pronominal suffix.
senses.grammatical_frame: Quantifier noun in construct before a demonstrative pronoun or relative אֲשֶׁר, or bearing a pronominal suffix

senses.definition: Refers broadly to everything as a whole or every respect in an absolute prepositional phrase.
senses.grammatical_frame: Absolute noun preceded by the preposition בְּ (בַּכֹּל)

collocations_and_notes: Predominantly occurs in the construct state (כָּל־, כֹּל) proclitic to a following noun, demonstrative, or relative particle, or with pronominal suffixes (כֻּלָּם in ISA 57:13; כֻּלָּהּ in AMO 9:5). Common fixed temporal and spatial expressions include כָּל־הַיָּמִים ("all the days / continually", DEU 28:33) and תַּחַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם ("under the whole sky", JOB 28:24). In negated clauses with גַּם אֶחָד ("not even one", 2SA 17:12), בְּכָל denotes any member of the group. In JDG 16:17, כְּכָל־הָאָדָם ("like all mankind") denotes ordinary people generally.
